    Retrieval as Exploration: Retriever-Free Retrieval via Corpus-Traversing MCTS

    将检索视为探索：通过遍历语料库的 MCTS 实现无检索器检索

    Chaeeun Kim, Seungone Kim

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    FREESON makes an LRM both reasoner and retriever by navigating corpus paths with MCTS, directly advancing multi-step reasoning and search strategy. Its unified architecture is a strong agent-systems contribution, while the representation-bottleneck discussion does not provide mechanistic analysis of internal representations.

    FREESON 通过 MCTS 遍历语料库路径，使 LRM 同时担任推理器和检索器，直接推动了多步推理和搜索策略的发展。其统一架构是对智能体系统的重要贡献；不过，对表征瓶颈的讨论并未提供内部表征的机制性分析。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in multi-step reasoning and calling search tools at appropriate steps. However, existing retrieval-augmented reasoning approaches still rely on separate retrieval models, limiting LRMs to deciding when to retrieve and how to formulate queries rather than leveraging their pretrained knowledge and reasoning capabilities for retrieval itself. This structural separation introduces a representation bottleneck, as retrieval relies on separately learned representations that may obscure fine-grained distinctions needed for reasoning. Moreover, these approaches commonly employ fixed top-k retrieval, which can introduce superfluous documents and increase retrieval noise and context overhead. To address this, we reformulate retrieval from query-document relevance matching into the exploration of answer-containing paths within the corpus, and propose FREESON (Retriever-FREE Retrieval-Augmented ReaSONing), a framework that enables LRMs to directly navigate the original corpus text to locate information that satisfies their specific needs, serving as both the reasoner and the retriever. Specifically, we introduce CT-MCTS (Corpus-Traversing Monte Carlo Tree Search), a retrieval-specialized variant of Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS). CT-MCTS iteratively expands and evaluates exploration paths, starting from multiple promising entry points across the corpus. This allows LRMs to selectively reference specific segments identified during traversal, instead of fetching a fixed top-k set. Across nine benchmarks, FREESON improves average EM and F1 by 15 points over four retriever-based baselines on five general-domain QA tasks, matching the strongest baseline. It also gains 12 points on fact-checking and 13 points on medical QA under zero-shot transfer, performing on par with the much larger MedGemma-27B.

    中文

    大型推理模型（LRM）已展现出出色的多步推理能力，并能在适当步骤调用搜索工具。然而，现有的检索增强推理方法仍依赖独立的检索模型，这使 LRM 只能决定何时检索以及如何构造查询，而无法利用其预训练知识和推理能力来执行检索本身。这种结构性分离造成了表征瓶颈，因为检索依赖单独学习的表征，而这些表征可能掩盖推理所需的细粒度差异。此外，这些方法通常采用固定的 top-k 检索，可能引入多余文档，增加检索噪声和上下文开销。为解决这一问题，我们将检索重新表述为在语料库中探索包含答案的路径，而不是进行查询与文档的相关性匹配，并提出 FREESON（无检索器检索增强推理），这是一个使 LRM 能够直接浏览原始语料库文本、查找满足特定需求的信息，并同时担任推理器和检索器的框架。具体而言，我们提出 CT-MCTS（语料库遍历蒙特卡洛树搜索），这是蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）的检索专用变体。CT-MCTS 从语料库中的多个有希望的起点出发，迭代扩展并评估探索路径。这样，LRM 就能有选择地引用遍历过程中识别出的特定片段，而不必获取固定的 top-k 文档集合。在九个基准测试中，在五项通用领域问答任务上，FREESON 的平均 EM 和 F1 比四种基于检索器的基线高 15 个百分点，达到最强基线的水平。在零样本迁移设置下，它在事实核查和医学问答上也分别提高了 12 和 13 个百分点，表现与规模大得多的 MedGemma-27B 相当。

    Stabilizing Knowledge, Promoting Reasoning: Dual-Token Constraints for RLVR

    稳定知识，促进推理：面向 RLVR 的双令牌约束

    Runze Liu, Jiakang Wang, Fuzheng Zhang, Xiu Li, Guorui Zhou, Kun Gai, Ling Pan

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Archer’s central contribution is an entropy-aware RLVR method that applies different update constraints to reasoning and knowledge tokens, with gains on math and code reasoning benchmarks. This directly advances reasoning training; token-type distinctions offer limited insight into model behavior but do not establish a mechanistic account of representations or storage.

    Archer 的核心贡献是一种熵感知 RLVR 方法，它对推理令牌和知识令牌采用不同的更新约束，并在数学和代码推理基准上取得提升。这直接推动了推理训练的发展；令牌类型的区分能有限地帮助理解模型行为，但并未建立关于表征或存储的机制性解释。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has become an effective post-training method for improving the reasoning abilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, existing methods mainly apply uniform optimization constraints across all tokens, ignoring their heterogeneous roles. Prior work shows that high-entropy tokens are closely tied to reasoning, while low-entropy tokens primarily encode factual knowledge, and recent approaches attempt to exploit this distinction by isolating token updates via masking or asynchronous training. We argue that retaining training signals across token types can lead to more effective learning. To address this, we propose Archer, an entropy-aware RLVR framework with dual-token constraints that preserves joint optimization while modulating update strength across token types. Our method introduces response-level entropy normalization for stable token classification and applies differentiated clipping ranges and KL regularization to encourage exploration on reasoning tokens while preserving knowledge tokens. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks show that Archer consistently outperforms strong baselines across multiple model scales, improving both pass@1 and pass@K performance. These results highlight the importance of respecting sequence-level dependencies when designing fine-grained RL optimization strategies for LLMs. The code is available at https://github.com/wizard-III/ArcherCodeR.

    中文

    带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）已成为提升大型语言模型（LLM）推理能力的有效后训练方法。然而，现有方法主要对所有令牌施加统一的优化约束，忽略了它们所承担角色的异质性。以往研究表明，高熵令牌与推理密切相关，而低熵令牌主要编码事实知识；近期方法尝试通过掩码或异步训练隔离令牌更新，以利用这一区别。我们认为，保留跨令牌类型的训练信号能够带来更有效的学习。为此，我们提出 Archer，这是一种具备双令牌约束的熵感知 RLVR 框架，在保留联合优化的同时，调节不同令牌类型的更新强度。我们的方法引入响应级熵归一化，以实现稳定的令牌分类，并采用差异化的裁剪范围和 KL 正则化，鼓励推理令牌进行探索，同时保留知识令牌。数学推理和代码生成基准上的实验表明，Archer 在多种模型规模下持续优于强基线，并同时提升 pass@1 和 pass@K 性能。这些结果凸显了在为 LLM 设计细粒度 RL 优化策略时，尊重序列级依赖关系的重要性。代码见 https://github.com/wizard-III/ArcherCodeR。

    Mechanistic Interpretability with Sparse Autoencoder Neural Operators

    利用稀疏自编码器神经算子实现机制可解释性

    Bahareh Tolooshams, Ailsa Shen, Anima Anandkumar

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops sparse autoencoders that represent concepts as structured functions, with joint concept and domain sparsity, and studies localization, stability, and generalization across resolutions. This directly advances mechanistic interpretability and representation structure; sparse composition offers a related but secondary connection to compositional representations.

    本文开发了将概念表示为结构化函数的稀疏自编码器，并采用概念与域的联合稀疏性，研究其定位能力、稳定性以及跨分辨率泛化能力。这直接推动了机制可解释性和表征结构研究；稀疏组合与组合式表征存在关联，但属于次要联系。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    We introduce sparse autoencoder neural operators (SAE-NOs), a new class of sparse autoencoders that operate in function spaces rather than fixed-dimensional Euclidean representations. We formalize the functional representation hypothesis, where data are explained through sparse compositions of structured functions. Unlike standard SAEs that represent concepts with scalar activations, SAE-NOs parameterize concepts as functions, enabling representations that capture not only a concept's presence, but also how and where it is expressed across the input domain. We achieve this through joint sparsity: concept sparsity selects active concepts, while domain sparsity governs where they are expressed. We instantiate this framework using Fourier neural operators (SAE-FNOs), parameterizing concepts as integral operators in the Fourier domain. This functional and spectral parameterization is particularly advantageous when data exhibit spatial structure across scales or when concepts are frequency-structured. We characterize SAE-FNO on vision data and demonstrate that it learns localized patterns, uses concepts more efficiently, and exhibits stable concept characteristics across sparsity levels. We further show that SAE-FNO adapts to changes in domain size and generalizes across discretizations, operating at resolutions beyond those seen during training, where standard SAEs fail. We also introduce lifting into SAEs and show theoretically and empirically that it acts as a preconditioner that accelerates optimization. Overall, our results show that moving from vector-valued to functional parameterizations, with concept and domain sparsity, extends SAEs from representing concept presence to modeling structured concept expression, highlighting the importance of parameterization.

    中文

    我们提出稀疏自编码器神经算子（SAE-NO），这是一类新型稀疏自编码器，其运作空间是函数空间，而非固定维度的欧几里得表征空间。我们形式化了函数表征假设：数据可通过结构化函数的稀疏组合来解释。标准 SAE 使用标量激活表示概念，而 SAE-NO 将概念参数化为函数，使表征不仅能捕捉概念是否存在，还能捕捉概念在输入域中如何以及何处表达。我们通过联合稀疏性实现这一点：概念稀疏性用于选择活跃概念，域稀疏性则决定这些概念在何处表达。我们使用傅里叶神经算子（SAE-FNO）实例化这一框架，将概念参数化为傅里叶域中的积分算子。当数据呈现跨尺度空间结构或概念具有频率结构时，这种函数式和谱域参数化尤其有利。我们在视觉数据上刻画 SAE-FNO，并展示它能够学习局部模式、更高效地使用概念，且概念特征在不同稀疏度水平下保持稳定。我们进一步表明，SAE-FNO 能适应域大小变化，并跨离散化方式泛化；它可以在训练中未见过的分辨率下运行，而标准 SAE 在这些分辨率下会失效。我们还将提升映射引入 SAE，并从理论和实证上表明，它能作为预条件器加速优化。总体而言，我们的结果表明，从向量值参数化转向函数式参数化，并结合概念稀疏性和域稀疏性，可使 SAE 从表示概念是否存在扩展到建模概念表达的结构，凸显了参数化方式的重要性。

    Staying in the Sweet Spot: Boost Reasoning Evolution via Responsive Rollout Difficulty Manipulation

    保持在最佳区间：通过响应式调节 rollout 难度促进推理进化

    Ziheng Li, Zexu Sun, Jinman Zhao, Erxue Min, Yongcheng Zeng, Hui Wu, Hengyi Cai, Shuaiqiang Wang, Dawei Yin, Xu Chen, Zhi-Hong Deng

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper proposes SEELE, which adapts hint length to problem difficulty during RLVR training, and evaluates its gains on math reasoning benchmarks. It directly targets reasoning capability development and exploration; its adaptive training procedure is only incidental to model systems, with no substantive systems contribution described.

    本文提出 SEELE，在 RLVR 训练过程中根据问题难度调整提示长度，并在数学推理基准上评估其提升效果。它直接着眼于推理能力的发展和探索；其自适应训练流程与模型系统仅有间接关联，文中没有描述实质性的系统贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has advanced the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). However, existing RLVR methods often suffer from exploration inefficiency due to mismatches between problem difficulty and model capability: overly difficult problems hinder reasoning path discovery, while overly simple problems offer little learning signal. To address this, we first formalize the effect of problem difficulty by quantifying the relationship between loss descent magnitude and rollout accuracy. Building on this analysis, we propose SEELE, a supervision-aided RLVR framework that dynamically adjusts problem difficulty to lie within the high-performance region. SEELE augments each training sample by appending a hint (part of a full solution) for difficulty reduction. Unlike previous hint-based approaches, SEELE deliberately computes the hint length for each individual problem to achieve an optimal difficulty. The optimal hint length is determined via multi-round rollout sampling, where an item response theory model fits accuracy-hint pairs from previous rounds to predict the next-round hint. This instance-level, real-time difficulty adjustment aligns problem difficulty with the evolving model capability, thereby improving exploration efficiency. Experiments show that SEELE outperforms Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and Supervised Fine-tuning (SFT) by +10.0 and +8.4 points, respectively, and exceeds the best prior supervision-aided approach by +3.8 points on average across six math reasoning benchmarks.

    中文

    带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）推动了大型语言模型（LLM）推理能力的发展。然而，现有 RLVR 方法常因问题难度与模型能力不匹配而探索效率低下：问题过难会妨碍推理路径的发现，问题过于简单则几乎不提供学习信号。为此，我们首先通过量化损失下降幅度与 rollout 准确率之间的关系，形式化问题难度的影响。在此分析基础上，我们提出 SEELE，这是一种由监督信号辅助的 RLVR 框架，可动态调整问题难度，使其处于高性能区间。SEELE 通过在每个训练样本后附加提示（完整解答的一部分）来降低难度。与以往基于提示的方法不同，SEELE 会针对每一道题有意计算提示长度，以达到最佳难度。最佳提示长度通过多轮 rollout 采样确定：项目反应理论模型根据前几轮的准确率与提示长度数据进行拟合，以预测下一轮所需的提示。此实例级实时难度调整使问题难度与不断演进的模型能力相匹配，从而提高探索效率。实验表明，在六个数学推理基准上，SEELE 平均超过 Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）和 Supervised Fine-tuning（SFT）10.0 和 8.4 个百分点，并比此前表现最好的监督辅助方法高 3.8 个百分点。

    MedMMV: A Controllable Multimodal Multi-Agent Framework for Reliable and Verifiable Clinical Reasoning

    MedMMV：用于可靠且可验证临床推理的可控多模态多智能体框架

    Hongjun Liu, Yinghao Zhu, Yuhui Wang, Yitao Long, Lequan Yu, Chen Zhao

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper proposes controlling reasoning by selecting among candidate trajectories, then trains models to prefer higher-quality paths, directly targeting reliable reasoning and its development. Multi-agent framing is present, but the contribution described centers on reasoning control rather than agent organization or internal mechanisms.

    本文提出通过从候选轨迹中进行选择来控制推理，并训练模型偏好质量更高的路径，直接着眼于可靠推理及其发展。文中采用了多智能体框架，但所述贡献的核心是推理控制，而非智能体组织或内部机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Current multimodal large language models (MLLMs) suffer from unstable reasoning due to the lack of mechanisms for controlling reasoning trajectories, often leading to hallucinated conclusions. Our analysis reveals that early-stage uncertainty induces trajectory switching, significantly increasing hallucination risk. We propose MedMMV, an evidence-grounded trajectory control framework that treats reasoning as a search-and-selection process over candidate trajectories. By constructing, refining, and selecting among multiple reasoning paths, MedMMV improves reliability and produces structured supervision signals over trajectory quality. We further convert these signals into learnable objectives for post-training, including reject sampling and pairwise preference learning, enabling smaller models to learn trajectory selection as an efficient single-pass capability. Instead of merely imitating reasoning traces, the model is trained to assign higher likelihood to preferred trajectories. Experiments show that richer supervision leads to stronger transfer, with accuracy improving from 10.5% to 29.0%. Our results demonstrate that trajectory selection is the key transferable capability for reliable reasoning.

    中文

    当前多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）缺乏控制推理轨迹的机制，因而推理不稳定，常常导致幻觉结论。我们的分析表明，早期阶段的不确定性会引发轨迹切换，显著增加幻觉风险。我们提出 MedMMV，这是一种以证据为依据的轨迹控制框架，将推理视为在候选轨迹之间进行搜索和选择的过程。通过构建、优化并从多条推理路径中进行选择，MedMMV 提高了可靠性，并生成关于轨迹质量的结构化监督信号。我们进一步将这些信号转化为可学习的后训练目标，包括拒绝采样和成对偏好学习，使较小的模型能够将轨迹选择学习为一种高效的单次前向能力。模型训练的目标不是单纯模仿推理过程，而是为偏好的轨迹赋予更高的似然。实验表明，更丰富的监督带来更强的迁移能力，准确率从 10.5% 提升至 29.0%。我们的结果表明，轨迹选择是实现可靠推理的关键可迁移能力。

    Knowing What is Missing: Efficient Conversational Memory via Explicit Evidence-Gap Tracking

    知其所缺：通过显式跟踪证据缺口实现高效的对话记忆

    Xingbo Du, Loka Li, Duzhen Zhang, Leonard Song, Le Song

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    MemR³ contributes an explicit evidence-gap state and retrieve/reflect/answer controller for efficient conversational memory, with gains on memory benchmarks. Its multi-step retrieval involves reasoning, but the central contribution is memory and agent control rather than a reasoning mechanism or compositional generalization.

    MemR³ 提出了显式的证据缺口状态以及检索／反思／回答控制器，以实现高效的对话记忆，并在记忆基准上取得提升。其多步检索涉及推理，但核心贡献是记忆与智能体控制，而非推理机制或组合式泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Long-term conversational memory poses a fundamental system challenge for LLM agents: reasoning over all past interactions improves coverage but incurs prohibitive token costs and noise, while retrieval-based methods are efficient yet often fail on multi-hop and temporal questions. Existing multi-step retrievers partially address this gap, but typically operate over an ever-growing textual history, causing context expansion and noise accumulation across iterations. We propose MemR$^3$, a backend-agnostic closed-loop controller that reformulates conversational memory retrieval as explicit stateful decision-making. At each iteration, MemR$^3$ maintains an evidence-gap state consisting of grounded information (evidence) and unresolved information requirements (gaps), and uses this state to route among three actions: retrieve, reflect, and answer. Newly retrieved snippets are incorporated into the state and then masked from subsequent prompts, so the model conditions on a compact summary of progress rather than the full retrieval history. This design turns multi-step memory retrieval into a bounded, inspectable control process whose query-time context scales with the state instead of raw accumulated text. Experiments on LongMemEval$_s$ show that MemR$^3$ surpasses implicit multi-step retrieval baselines and often approaches or exceeds full-context prompting while retrieving only 1%-5% of the full conversation tokens on long conversations. On LoCoMo, MemR$^3$ consistently improves over its underlying RAG- and Zep-based memory backbones. These results suggest that explicit evidence-gap tracking is an effective abstraction for token-efficient conversational memory.

    中文

    长期对话记忆给 LLM 智能体带来了根本性的系统挑战：对所有过往交互进行推理有助于提高覆盖率，但会产生高昂的令牌成本和噪声；基于检索的方法虽然高效，却常常无法处理多跳和时间相关问题。现有的多步检索器在一定程度上弥补了这一差距，但通常在不断增长的文本历史上运行，导致上下文在各轮迭代中不断扩张、噪声不断累积。我们提出 MemR$^3$，这是一种与后端无关的闭环控制器，将对话记忆检索重新表述为显式的有状态决策过程。在每次迭代中，MemR$^3$都会维护一个证据缺口状态，其中包含有依据的信息（证据）和尚未解决的信息需求（缺口），并利用该状态在三种操作之间进行路由：检索、反思和回答。新检索到的片段会并入状态，随后在后续提示中屏蔽，因此模型依据的是对进展的精简摘要，而非完整的检索历史。这种设计将多步记忆检索转变为有界且可检查的控制过程，使查询时的上下文规模随状态而变化，而不是随累积的原始文本增长。LongMemEval$_s$上的实验表明，MemR$^3$优于隐式多步检索基线；在长对话上仅检索全部对话令牌的 1%-5%，其表现通常可接近甚至超过完整上下文提示。在 LoCoMo 上，MemR$^3$始终优于其底层基于 RAG 和 Zep 的记忆骨干模型。这些结果表明，显式跟踪证据缺口是实现令牌高效对话记忆的一种有效抽象。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    BoT jointly analyzes related queries to reuse reasoning patterns, detect inconsistencies, and reduce inference costs, with theoretical and experimental analysis of when batch-aware reasoning helps. This directly advances reasoning, while its multi-agent reflection architecture and computational savings also make a substantial systems contribution; cross-instance reuse alone provides only limited evidence for compositional generalization.

    BoT 联合分析相关查询，以复用推理模式、发现不一致并降低推理成本，同时通过理论和实验分析探讨批次感知推理何时有益。这直接推动了推理研究；其多智能体反思架构和计算节省也构成了实质性的系统贡献。仅凭跨实例复用，为组合式泛化提供的证据有限。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Current Large Language Model reasoning systems process queries independently, discarding valuable cross-instance signals such as shared reasoning patterns and consistency constraints. We introduce Batch-of-Thought (BoT), a training-free method that processes related queries jointly to enable cross-instance learning. By performing comparative analysis across queries, BoT identifies high-quality reasoning templates, detects errors through consistency checks, and amortizes computational costs. We instantiate BoT within a multi-agent reflection architecture (BoT-R), where a Reflector performs joint evaluation to unlock mutual information gain unavailable in isolated processing. Experiments across three model families and six benchmarks demonstrate that BoT-R consistently improves accuracy and confidence calibration while reducing inference costs by up to 61%. Our theoretical and experimental analysis reveals when and why batch-aware reasoning benefits LLM systems. Our code is available at https://github.com/xuanyang19/BoT.

    Mosaic: Unlocking Over 30$\times$ Context Length for Diffusion LLMs Inference via Global Memory Planning and Dynamic Peak Taming

    Mosaic：突破 30$\times$ 上下文长度限制：通过全局内存规划和动态峰值控制实现扩散式 LLM 推理

    Liang Zheng, Bowen Shi, Yitao Hu, Jiawei Zhang, Ruofan Li, Guotao Yang, Zhixin Zhao, Zhengchao Wang, Sheng Chen, Wenxin Li, Dezhi Ran, Tao Xie, Keqiu Li

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper presents dynamic memory planning and peak control for diffusion LLM inference, substantially advancing model computation and memory organization. Its mention of global planning and iterative refinement describes the model paradigm, but the contribution is an inference system rather than an advance in reasoning or composition.

    本文为扩散式 LLM 推理提出动态内存规划和峰值控制，显著推动了模型计算和内存组织的发展。文中提到的全局规划和迭代优化描述的是模型范式；其贡献在于推理系统，而非推理能力或组合能力的提升。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Diffusion-based large language models (dLLMs) have emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive models, leveraging simultaneous denoising to enable global planning and iterative refinement. These properties make dLLMs attractive for long-context generation. However, deploying dLLMs faces a prohibitive memory barrier, as existing inference systems are inefficient for the diffusion paradigm. We observe that current inference systems are misaligned with dLLMs. Unlike autoregressive models, whose memory footprint is dominated by the KV-Cache, dLLMs are bottlenecked by transient activations rematerialized per step. Moreover, generic memory reuse mechanisms lack the global visibility to handle dynamic memory peaks of dLLMs, which alternate between logits and feed-forward networks. To address these challenges, we present Mosaic, a memory-efficient inference system that shifts dLLM execution from local, static management to a global, dynamic paradigm. Mosaic integrates (i) a mask-only logits kernel eliminating redundant activation materialization, (ii) a lazy chunking optimizer using online heuristics to tame dynamic memory peaks, and (iii) a global memory manager leveraging virtual addressing to mitigate memory fragmentation. Evaluations show that Mosaic reduces the memory peak-to-average ratio by 2.71$\times$ on average and increases the maximum inference sequence length on identical hardware by 15.30-32.34$\times$. Crucially, Mosaic is training-free and preserves exact model outputs, while reducing end-to-end latency by 2.5%-55.4%. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/flashserve/Mosaic.

    中文

    基于扩散的大型语言模型（dLLM）已成为自回归模型的一种有前景的替代方案，它利用同步去噪实现全局规划和迭代优化。这些特性使 dLLM 适合长上下文生成。然而，部署 dLLM 面临难以承受的内存瓶颈，因为现有推理系统对扩散范式的支持效率低下。我们观察到，当前推理系统与 dLLM 并不匹配。自回归模型的内存占用主要由 KV-Cache 主导，而 dLLM 的瓶颈在于每一步重新物化的瞬时激活。此外，通用内存复用机制缺乏全局视野，无法处理 dLLM 的动态内存峰值；这些峰值会在 logits 和前馈网络之间交替出现。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 Mosaic，这是一种高内存效率的推理系统，将 dLLM 执行从局部、静态管理转向全局、动态管理。Mosaic 集成了：(i) 仅使用掩码的 logits 内核，以消除冗余的激活物化；(ii) 使用在线启发式方法抑制动态内存峰值的惰性分块优化器；(iii) 利用虚拟寻址缓解内存碎片的全局内存管理器。评估表明，Mosaic 平均将内存峰均比降低 2.71$\times$，并在相同硬件上将最大推理序列长度提高 15.30-32.34$\times$。关键的是，Mosaic 无需训练且能精确保留模型输出，同时将端到端延迟降低 2.5%-55.4%。代码已公开发布于 https://github.com/flashserve/Mosaic。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    LAMaS learns orchestration that penalizes latency on the critical path and skips pending work based on partial results, reducing multi-agent latency while preserving accuracy. This directly advances agent organization and execution; composition and reasoning are incidental to orchestration rather than substantive contributions.

    LAMaS 学习一种编排策略，对关键路径施加延迟惩罚，并根据部分结果跳过尚未开始的工作，从而在保持准确率的同时降低多智能体系统的延迟。这直接推动了智能体组织与执行；组合和推理只是编排中的附带因素，并非实质性贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    In a multi-agent system (MAS), removing an expensive agent call can save tokens without making the answer arrive sooner: latency depends on the longest chain of dependent calls. We present Latency-Aware Multi-agent System (LAMaS), a modular platform for learning low-latency orchestration. A framework can send a query to LAMaS and receive an answer and execution trace, or keep its own graph builder and use the platform's latency-optimized orchestration layer. During training, the layer gives operators on the critical path the greatest latency penalty while targeting a floor on expected accuracy. During inference, a lightweight controller uses partial results to decide whether to skip work that has yet to start. Across four benchmarks, LAMaS reduces end-to-end latency by over 50% relative to the evaluated learning-based MAS baselines while maintaining competitive or better accuracy. GDesigner and AgentDropout retain their graph builders and train the controller on their own traces; both achieve lower latency across the same benchmarks.

    Chung-En Sun, Ge Yan, Zimo Wang, Tsui-Wei Weng

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper turns steering directions into selective, interpretable edits to attention heads and MLP neurons, directly studying how model components mediate behavior.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Steering methods influence Large Language Model behavior by identifying semantic directions in hidden representations, but are typically realized through inference-time activation interventions that apply a fixed, global modification to the model's internal states. While effective, such interventions often induce unfavorable attribute-utility trade-offs under strong control, as they ignore the fact that many behaviors are governed by a small and heterogeneous subset of model components. We propose Steer2Edit, a theoretically grounded, training-free framework that transforms steering vectors from inference-time control signals into diagnostic signals for component-level rank-1 weight editing. Instead of uniformly injecting a steering direction during generation, Steer2Edit selectively redistributes behavioral influence across individual attention heads and MLP neurons, yielding interpretable edits that preserve the standard forward pass and remain compatible with optimized parallel inference. Across safety alignment, hallucination mitigation, and reasoning efficiency, Steer2Edit consistently achieves more favorable attribute-utility trade-offs: at matched downstream performance, it improves safety by up to 17.2%, increases truthfulness by 9.8%, and reduces reasoning length by 12.2% on average. Overall, Steer2Edit provides a principled bridge between representation steering and weight editing by translating steering signals into interpretable, training-free parameter updates. Our code is available at https://github.com/Trustworthy-ML-Lab/Steer2Edit

    中文

    引导方法通过识别隐藏表征中的语义方向来影响大型语言模型的行为，但通常是在推理时进行激活干预，对模型内部状态施加固定的全局修改。虽然这类干预有效，但在强控制下往往会导致不利的属性—效用权衡，因为它们忽略了许多行为由少数异质模型组件所支配这一事实。我们提出 Steer2Edit，这是一种有理论依据的免训练框架，可将引导向量从推理时控制信号转化为组件级秩一权重编辑的诊断信号。Steer2Edit 不会在生成过程中均匀注入引导方向，而是选择性地在各个注意力头和 MLP 神经元之间重新分配行为影响，从而产生可解释的编辑，同时保留标准前向传播，并与优化后的并行推理兼容。在安全对齐、幻觉缓解和推理效率方面，Steer2Edit 始终能实现更有利的属性—效用权衡：在下游性能相当时，安全性最高提升 17.2%，真实性提高 9.8%，推理长度平均减少 12.2%。总体而言，Steer2Edit 通过将引导信号转化为可解释、免训练的参数更新，为表征引导与权重编辑搭建了一个有原则的桥梁。我们的代码见 https://github.com/Trustworthy-ML-Lab/Steer2Edit。

    Boule 还是 Baguette？关于任务拓扑、长度泛化与推理轨迹效益的研究

    William L. Tong, Ege Cakar, Cengiz Pehlevan

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper studies how reasoning traces affect proof length generalization across task depth and breadth, supported by a large propositional logic benchmark and theory for a simpler inference task. This directly advances reasoning capability evaluation and understanding, while compositional structure is a controlled factor rather than the central contribution.

    本文研究推理轨迹如何影响证明长度泛化，并考察任务深度和广度的作用；研究借助大型命题逻辑基准，以及针对较简单推理任务建立的理论。这直接推动了推理能力评估与理解；组合结构是受控考察的因素，而非核心贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Recent years have witnessed meteoric progress in reasoning models: neural networks that generate intermediate reasoning traces (RTs) before producing a final output. Despite the rapid advancement, our understanding of how RTs support reasoning, and where this paradigm fails, remain incomplete. To promote greater clarity, we introduce PITA: a novel large-scale dataset of over 23 million statements in propositional logic and their corresponding proofs. As a benchmark for robust reasoning, we focus on length generalization: if a model is trained to determine truth or falsity on statements with proofs up to fixed length, how well does it generalize to statements requiring longer proofs? We propose notions of (1) task depth and (2) task breadth, which measure respectively (1) the number of proof steps required to solve a proposition and (2) the number of unique propositions within a task family. We vary these quantities across subsets of PITA, and find that RT models generalize well on relatively broad and shallow subsets, while deteriorating on relatively narrow and deep subsets compared to non-RT baselines. As a controlled point of comparison, we study a separate, tractable transitive inference task that exhibits qualitatively similar behavior. Our accompanying theory explains the scalings observed in this simpler setting, suggesting one mechanism by which breadth can favor RT models while depth can expose long-context weaknesses. Our findings suggest salient benefits and limitations of proof-like reasoning traces in controlled length-generalization settings.

    中文

    近年来，推理模型取得了突飞猛进的进展：这类神经网络会先生成中间推理轨迹（RT），再给出最终输出。尽管发展迅速，我们对 RT 如何支持推理，以及这种范式会在哪些地方失效，仍缺乏完整认识。为增进理解，我们推出 PITA：一个新型大型数据集，包含超过 2300 万条命题逻辑陈述及其对应证明。作为稳健推理基准，我们聚焦于长度泛化：如果模型经过训练，能够判断证明长度不超过固定值的陈述为真或为假，那么对于需要更长证明的陈述，它能泛化得如何？我们提出（1）任务深度和（2）任务广度的概念，分别衡量（1）求解一个命题所需的证明步骤数，以及（2）一个任务族中不同命题的数量。我们在 PITA 的不同子集上改变这些量，并发现，与非 RT 基线相比，RT 模型在相对广泛且浅层的子集上泛化良好，而在相对狭窄且深层的子集上表现会下降。作为受控对照，我们研究了一项独立且易于处理的传递推理任务，观察到定性上相似的行为。配套理论解释了这一更简单设定下观察到的规模规律，揭示了广度可能如何有利于 RT 模型，而深度又可能暴露其长上下文弱点的一种机制。我们的发现揭示了在受控长度泛化设置中，类证明推理轨迹的显著优势与局限。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    BFS-PO trains reasoning models to find shorter correct chains through best-first search, backtracking, and reinforcement learning, directly targeting reasoning capability and computation during training. Search-tree organization has a secondary systems connection, while compositional generalization and model internals are not addressed.

    BFS-PO 通过最佳优先搜索、回溯和强化学习来训练推理模型寻找更短的正确推理链，直接针对训练期间的推理能力和计算开销。搜索树组织方式与系统有次要关联，而本文未涉及组合泛化和模型内部机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) have shown excellent performance in reasoning tasks using long Chains of Thought (CoTs). However, this has also led to a significant increase of computational costs and the generation of verbose output, a phenomenon known as overthinking. The tendency to overthink is often exacerbated by Reinforcement Learning (RL) algorithms such as GRPO/DAPO. In this paper, we propose BFS-PO, an RL algorithm which alleviates this problem using a Best-First Search exploration strategy. Specifically, the reasoning chains generated at training time by BFS-PO are organized into a search tree, within which the shortest correct sequence is selected as the best and expanded using a backtracking mechanism based on maximum entropy nodes. In this way, we bias the exploration of the solution space towards the search for increasingly shorter solutions, training the LRM to generate progressively more concise answers. Using different benchmarks and base LRMs, we show that BFS-PO can simultaneously increase the LRM accuracy and shorten its reasoning chains.

    Training selects for behavior, not circuitry: many weight configurations can implement the same function. Studying any single trained neural network thus risks describing accidents of one training run rather than the computation itself. This work shifts focus from what transformers happen to do to what they must do by extracting algorithmic cores, compact subspaces that are necessary and sufficient for a task and that recur across independently trained models. Here, Algorithmic Core Extraction (ACE) is introduced to isolate these subspaces, causally validate them, and recover the algorithms they implement, from synthetic tasks to large pretrained models. Markov-chain transformers embed 3D cores in nearly orthogonal subspaces yet recover identical transition spectra. Modular-addition transformers form compact cyclic cores at grokking that later inflate under continued regularization, redundantly distributing the same computation across many functionally equivalent modes. This functional redundancy accelerates the transition from memorization to generalization, yielding an inverse scaling law for grokking time. In six language models spanning two orders of magnitude in scale (GPT-2 Small/Medium/Large, LLaMA-3.1, Gemma-2, and Qwen2.5), subject-verb agreement is governed by a single, steerable axis that aligns across architectures. Flipping this axis inverts grammatical number throughout open-ended generation. For indirect object identification, a multi-step task, the same six models route computation through compact multi-dimensional cores at two sites, linked by a linear operator that transfers across model families. Together these results suggest that beneath the apparent complexity of trained transformers lies a simpler, shared computational structure, and that targeting invariants rather than parameterizations may offer a more tractable path to mechanistic understanding and control.

    中文

    训练选择的是行为，而非电路：许多不同的权重配置都能实现相同的函数。因此，研究任何一个单独训练出的神经网络，都有可能描述某次训练运行的偶然结果，而非计算本身。本工作通过提取算法核心，将关注点从 Transformer 恰好做了什么转向它必然要做什么。算法核心是对某项任务必不可少且足以完成该任务、并且会在独立训练的模型中反复出现的紧凑子空间。本文提出算法核心提取（ACE），用于分离这些子空间、进行因果验证，并恢复它们所实现的算法，研究范围从合成任务延伸到大型预训练模型。马尔可夫链 Transformer 将 3D 核心嵌入近乎正交的子空间，却恢复出相同的转移谱。模块加法 Transformer 在 grokking 阶段形成紧凑的循环核心，随后在持续正则化下膨胀，将相同计算冗余地分布到许多功能等价的模式中。这种功能冗余加速了从记忆到泛化的转变，从而产生了 grokking 时间的反向缩放定律。在六个跨越两个数量级规模的语言模型（GPT-2 Small/Medium/Large、LLaMA-3.1、Gemma-2 和 Qwen2.5）中，主谓一致由一个跨架构对齐、可操控的单一轴控制。翻转这一轴会使开放式生成中的语法数反转。对于间接宾语识别这一多步任务，同样的六个模型会通过两个位置上的紧凑多维核心来路由计算，这两个核心由一个可跨模型系列迁移的线性算子连接。总之，这些结果表明，训练后 Transformer 表面复杂性之下存在一种更简单、共享的计算结构；与其针对参数化形式，针对不变量可能为实现机制理解与控制提供一条更易处理的路径。

    面向扩散 LLM 的强化学习：熵引导的步骤选择与逐步优势

    Vishnu Teja Kunde, Fatemeh Doudi, Mahdi Farahbakhsh, Dileep Kalathil, Krishna Narayanan, Jean-Francois Chamberland

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper formulates diffusion generation as a finite-horizon decision process and derives an unbiased, stepwise policy gradient with entropy-guided updates and practical advantage estimates, improving reasoning benchmarks. Its contribution directly advances reasoning training; denoising-step selection gives a limited connection to adaptive computation, while composition and interpretability are not substantive topics.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Reinforcement learning (RL) has been effective for post-training autoregressive (AR) language models, but extending these methods to diffusion language models (DLMs) is challenging due to intractable sequence-level likelihoods. Existing approaches therefore rely on surrogate likelihoods or heuristic approximations, which can introduce bias and obscure the sequential structure of denoising. We formulate diffusion-based sequence generation as a finite-horizon Markov decision process over the denoising trajectory and derive an exact, unbiased policy gradient that decomposes over denoising steps and is expressed in terms of intermediate advantages, without requiring explicit evaluation of the sequence likelihood. To obtain a practical and compute-efficient estimator, we (i) select denoising steps for policy updates via an entropy-guided approximation bound, and (ii) estimate intermediate advantages using a one-step denoising reward naturally provided by the diffusion model, avoiding costly multi-step rollouts. Experiments on coding and logical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art results, with strong competitive performance on mathematical reasoning, outperforming existing RL post-training approaches for DLMs. Code is available at https://github.com/vishnutez/egspo-dllm-rl.

    强化学习（RL）已有效用于自回归（AR）语言模型的后训练，但由于序列级似然难以处理，将这些方法扩展到扩散语言模型（DLM）颇具挑战。现有方法因此依赖替代似然或启发式近似，这可能引入偏差，并模糊去噪的序列结构。我们将基于扩散的序列生成表述为沿去噪轨迹进行的有限时域马尔可夫决策过程，并推导出一种精确、无偏的策略梯度。该梯度按去噪步骤分解，并以中间优势表示，无需显式评估序列似然。为了获得实用且计算高效的估计器，我们（i）通过熵引导的近似界为策略更新选择去噪步骤；（ii）利用扩散模型自然提供的一步去噪奖励来估计中间优势，从而避免代价高昂的多步展开。在代码和逻辑推理基准上的实验取得了最先进的结果，在数学推理方面也表现出强劲竞争力，优于现有面向 DLM 的 RL 后训练方法。代码见 https://github.com/vishnutez/egspo-dllm-rl。

    The paper introduces a Riemannian geometry-based metric for comparing neural representations and applies it to distinguish computations across network regimes, recurrent models, and diffusion models.     ENGLISH

    Similarity measures such as centred kernel alignment (CKA) or representational similarity analysis (RSA) are widely used to compare the representational geometries employed by different neural networks to solve the same task. Yet, because existing methods compare the extrinsic geometry of representations in state space, rather than their intrinsic geometry, they may fail to capture subtle yet crucial distinctions between fundamentally different computations. Here, we introduce metric similarity analysis (MSA), a novel method which leverages tools from Riemannian geometry to compare the intrinsic geometry of neural representations under the manifold hypothesis. We show that MSA can be used to (i) disentangle neural computations of deep networks in rich vs. lazy learning regimes, (ii) compare the dynamics of recurrent neural networks and state-space models, and (iii) investigate the statistical manifolds of diffusion models. Overall, we introduce a mathematically grounded and broadly applicable framework to understand the mechanisms behind neural computations by contrasting their intrinsic geometries.

    Shifting the Gradient: Understanding How Defensive Training Methods Protect Language Model Integrity

    转移梯度：理解防御性训练方法如何保护语言模型完整性

    Satchel Grant, Victor Gillioz, Jake Ward, Thomas McGrath

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper causally analyzes how two defensive training methods alter activation gradients along a trait direction, establishing distinct mechanisms across traits and models; this directly advances mechanistic interpretability. Its findings concern training effects on trait acquisition, a partial connection to reasoning and capability development, but not composition or system organization.

    本文对两种防御性训练方法如何改变特质方向上的激活梯度进行了因果分析，揭示了它们在不同特质和模型上的不同机制，直接推进了机制可解释性。其发现涉及训练对特质习得的影响，与推理和能力发展有部分关联，但不涉及组合性或系统组织。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Defensive training methods such as positive preventative steering (PPS) and inoculation prompting (IP) offer surprising results through seemingly similar processes: both add trait-inducing objects to large language models (LLMs) during training, and both defend the LLM against acquiring the trait. The success of these methods raises the questions: how do they work, and are they doing the same thing? We provide behavioral and mechanistic analyses of PPS and IP, using the acquisition of an ``evil'' persona by Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct as an in-depth case study and replicating key measurements across six traits and four models. Behaviorally, neither method operates through a purely associative mechanism, and both methods prevent trait acquisition; but PPS can also substantially reduce pre-existing trait expression, whereas IP does so only modestly. Mechanistically, PPS induces a concentrated change in the activation gradient and shifts the signal along the trait direction from amplifying to attenuating, whereas IP changes the gradient more diffusely and shifts it close to zero along the trait direction. Gradient manipulations show that the direction of this component is causally relevant to trait acquisition, although it is one effect rather than a complete account of either defense. We then show that IP lowers the next-token prediction loss on trait-expressing data, whereas PPS can raise it at the intensities at which it defends; we show how this analysis raises the possibility that the loss changes and the gradient shift are two summaries of the same training signal rather than completely separate mechanisms. Together, our results show that PPS and IP are not interchangeable, and they highlight open questions about a complete mechanistic picture.

    诸如正向预防性转向（PPS）和接种提示（IP）等防御性训练方法，通过看似相似的过程取得了出人意料的结果：二者都会在训练期间向大型语言模型（LLM）中加入诱导特质的对象，并且都能防止 LLM 获得该特质。这些方法的成功引出了以下问题：它们如何发挥作用？二者做的是同一件事吗？我们对 PPS 和 IP 进行了行为与机制分析，以 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 获得“邪恶”人格为深入案例研究，并在六种特质和四个模型上复现了关键测量结果。从行为上看，任何一种方法都不是通过纯粹的联想机制发挥作用的，而且两种方法都能防止特质习得；但 PPS 还可以大幅降低已有特质的表达，而 IP 只能适度降低。从机制上看，PPS 会引发集中的激活梯度变化，并使特质方向上的信号从放大转为衰减；而 IP 会更分散地改变梯度，并使特质方向上的信号趋近于零。梯度操控表明，这一分量的方向与特质习得存在因果关系，尽管它只是其中一种作用，并不能完整解释任一防御方法。随后我们表明，IP 会降低特质表达数据上的下一 token 预测损失，而 PPS 在其发挥防御作用的强度下可能会提高该损失；我们还指出，这项分析提出一种可能性：损失变化和梯度转移是同一训练信号的两种概括，而非完全独立的机制。总之，我们的结果表明 PPS 和 IP 不可互换，并凸显了构建完整机制图景仍有待解决的问题。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    ANCORA trains a policy to generate and solve verifiable problems, using verifier-guided self-play and a curriculum that can expand through self-composition; it directly advances reasoning capability development and substantially supports composition-based curriculum growth. Its policy organization is incidental to agent systems, and no internal representations are analyzed.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    We propose a paradigm shift toward open-ended curriculum self-play: rather than learning to answer on a fixed prompt set, a unified policy learns to question: generating verifiable problems, solving them, and turning verifier feedback into self-improvement. We introduce ANCORA, in which the policy alternates between a Proposer that synthesizes novel specifications and a Solver that produces verified solutions, anchored by three mechanisms: a two-level group-relative update coupling Proposer advantages across specifications with Solver advantages across solution attempts; iterative self-distilled SFT projecting the base model onto its valid-output manifold before RL; and a UCB-guided Curriculum DAG whose policy-induced problem set can provably expand under self-composition. Without these stabilizers, sparse verifier feedback drives Proposer collapse even under MLRL-aligned rewards; with them, ANCORA bootstraps a verifiable curriculum from curated seeds. Instantiated in Verus, ANCORA lifts Dafny2Verus pass@1 from a 26.6% SFT baseline to 81.5% in test-time training (TTT, 0-shot), outperforming PSV self-play (1-shot) by 15.8 points; in a transfer setting, training from Dafny2Verus seeds yields 36.2% and 17.2% pass@1 on MBPP and HumanEval.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper mathematically links task-vector geometry to transformer behavior, identifying distinct internal mechanisms for Bayesian task retrieval and out-of-distribution extrapolation, a core contribution to representation geometry.     ENGLISH

    Transformers are effective at inferring the latent task from context via two inference modes: recognizing a task seen during training, and adapting to a novel one. Recent interpretability studies have identified from middle-layer representations task-specific directions, or task vectors, that steer model behavior. However, a lack of rigorous foundations hinders connecting internal representations to external model behavior: existing work fails to explain how task-vector geometry is shaped by the training distribution, and what geometry enables out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization. In this paper, we study these questions in a controlled synthetic setting by training small transformers from scratch on latent-task sequence distributions, which allows a principled mathematical characterization. We show that two inference modes can coexist within a single model. In-distribution behavior is governed by Bayesian task retrieval, implemented internally through convex combinations of learned task vectors. OOD behavior, by contrast, arises through extrapolative task learning, whose representations occupy a subspace nearly orthogonal to the task-vector subspace. Taken together, our results suggest that task-vector geometry, training distributions, and generalization behaviors are closely related.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper trains reusable task-family skills with compact state and step-level rewards, improving agent workflows while reducing prompt context.     Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly used to operate browsers, files, code and tools, making personal assistants a natural deployment target. Yet personal agents face a privacy-cost-capability tension: cloud models execute multi-step workflows well but expose sensitive intermediate context to external APIs, while local models preserve privacy but remain less reliable. Both settings also pay repeatedly for long skill prompts and growing histories. We propose constant-context skill learning, a context-to-weights framework for recurring agent workflows: reusable procedures are learned in lightweight task-family modules, while inference conditions only on the current observation and a compact state block. A deterministic tracker renders this state block from task progress and supplies aligned subgoal rewards, so each module can be trained with step-level SFT and refined through online RL. Across ALFWorld, WebShop, and SciWorld, our agents achieve strong performance across Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-14B, and Llama-3.1-8B. With Qwen3-8B, SFT+RL reaches 89.6% unseen success on ALFWorld, 76.8% success on WebShop, and 66.4% unseen success on SciWorld. They match or exceed strong published agent-training results while reducing prompt tokens per turn by 2-7x relative to controlled ReAct prompting baselines, showing that procedural context can be moved from prompts into weights. Code is available at https://github.com/haoyangxie/constant-context-skill-learning.

    大型语言模型（LLM）智能体日益广泛地用于操作浏览器、文件、代码和工具，使个人助理成为自然的部署目标。然而，个人智能体面临隐私、成本与能力之间的张力：云端模型能够良好执行多步工作流，却会将敏感的中间上下文暴露给外部 API；本地模型能够保护隐私，但可靠性仍较低。两种设置也都要反复承担长技能提示和不断增长的历史记录所带来的开销。我们提出恒定上下文技能学习，这是一种面向重复性智能体工作流的上下文到权重框架：在轻量级任务族模块中学习可复用流程，而推理时只以当前观察和紧凑状态块为条件。确定性跟踪器根据任务进度生成该状态块，并提供对齐的子目标奖励，因此每个模块都可以通过逐步 SFT 进行训练，再通过在线 RL 加以改进。在 ALFWorld、WebShop 和 SciWorld 上，我们的智能体在 Qwen3-4B、Qwen3-8B、Qwen3-14B 和 Llama-3.1-8B 上均取得了良好表现。使用 Qwen3-8B 时，SFT+RL 在 ALFWorld 上达到 89.6% 的未见任务成功率，在 WebShop 上达到 76.8% 的成功率，并在 SciWorld 上达到 66.4% 的未见任务成功率。与受控的 ReAct 提示基线相比，它们达到或超过了已发表的强智能体训练结果，同时将每轮提示 token 数减少了 2-7 倍，这表明可以将程序性上下文从提示转移到权重中。代码见 https://github.com/haoyangxie/constant-context-skill-learning。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    TGPO directly addresses reasoning capability development by combining teacher-guided token generation with trajectory-level rewards to improve on-policy reasoning distillation under large policy divergence.     ENGLISH

    On-policy distillation (OPD) has become a promising paradigm for reasoning-oriented post-training of large language models (LLMs), especially when combined with reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR). Existing OPD methods rely on reverse KL (RKL)-based teacher supervision over trajectories sampled from the student policy. However, we identify a critical limitation: under large teacher--student policy divergence, RL-driven exploration often produces trajectories outside the teacher distribution, resulting in uninformative negative feedback. To address this, we propose Teacher-Guided Policy Optimization (TGPO), an on-policy reasoning distillation method that remains effective under large policy divergence settings. Rather than relying solely on evaluative supervision, TGPO uses teacher to directly guide token level generation conditioning on student-generated contexts; together with RLVR-style trajectory level rewards, TGPO steers exploration toward improved continuations. Experiments on reasoning benchmarks show that TGPO consistently outperforms existing RKL-based OPD methods and remains robust across different teacher models.

    Pause and Reflect: Conformal Aggregation for Chain-of-Thought Reasoning

    暂停并反思：思维链推理的保形聚合

    Yu Gu, Zijun Yu, Vahid Partovi Nia, Masoud Asgharian

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops conformal aggregation and abstention for chain-of-thought paths, with finite-sample control of confidently wrong answers and evaluated accuracy gains. Its inference-time use is a limited systems connection; the main contribution targets reasoning reliability.

    本文为思维链路径提出保形聚合与弃答方法，对自信答错进行有限样本控制，并评估其准确率增益。该方法在推理时运行，与系统的联系有限；其主要贡献在于提升推理可靠性。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning with self-consistency improves performance by aggregating multiple sampled reasoning paths. In this setting, correctness is no longer tied to a single reasoning trace but to the aggregation rule over a pool of candidate paths, making aggregation uncertainty the central challenge. This issue is critical where confidently incorrect answers are far more costly than abstentions. We introduce a conformal procedure for CoT reasoning that directly addresses aggregation uncertainty. Our approach replaces majority voting with weighted score aggregation over reasoning paths and calibrates an abstention rule using conformal risk control. This approach leads to finite-sample guarantees on the confident-error rate--the probability that the system answers and is wrong. We further identify score separability as the key condition under which abstention provably improves selective accuracy, and derive closed-form expressions that predict accuracy gains from calibration data alone. The method is fully inference-time, and requires no retraining. Across four benchmarks, four open-source models, and three score classes, realized confident-error rates are consistent with the prescribed targets up to calibration-split and test-set variability. Our method achieves $90.1\%$ selective accuracy on GSM8K by abstaining on fewer than $5\%$ of problems, compared with $82.3\%$ accuracy under majority voting and $87.4\%$ under score-weighted voting without abstention, while conformal risk control keeps the expected rate of confidently wrong answers below $10\%$.

    中文

    结合自一致性的思维链（CoT）推理通过聚合多个采样得到的推理路径来提升性能。在这种设置下，正确性不再取决于单条推理轨迹，而取决于对一组候选路径采用的聚合规则，因此聚合不确定性成为核心挑战。在自信地答错远比弃答代价更高的场景中，这一问题至关重要。我们提出一种用于 CoT 推理的保形方法，直接应对聚合不确定性。我们的方法以加权分数聚合推理路径，取代多数投票，并通过保形风险控制校准弃答规则。这种方法为自信错误率——即系统作答且答案错误的概率——提供有限样本保证。我们还指出，分数可分性是弃答能够被证明提升选择性准确率的关键条件，并推导出仅凭校准数据即可预测准确率增益的闭式表达。该方法完全在推理时运行，无需重新训练。在四个基准、四个开源模型和三类分数上，实际自信错误率与预设目标一致，差异处于校准集划分和测试集波动范围内。我们的方法在 GSM8K 上实现$90.1\%$的选择性准确率，弃答的问题不足$5\%$，而多数投票的准确率为$82.3\%$，不弃答时基于分数加权投票的准确率为$87.4\%$；同时，保形风险控制将自信答错的期望比例维持在$10\%$以下。

    Amin Sghaier, Ali Parviz, Alexia Jolicoeur-Martineau

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    PTRM uses stochastic exploration over recursive latent-state trajectories and a Q head to select solutions, directly improving test-time reasoning without retraining. Its adaptive compute and parallel trajectories also make a strong Systems contribution, while puzzle solving alone provides only a limited connection to compositional generalization.

    PTRM 对递归潜在状态轨迹进行随机探索，并用 Q 头选择解，无需重新训练即可直接提升测试时推理能力。其自适应计算和并行轨迹也构成了重要的系统贡献；而单纯的谜题求解与组合泛化的联系有限。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Tiny Recursive Models (TRM) solve complex reasoning tasks with a fraction of the parameters of modern large language models (LLMs) by iteratively refining a latent state and final answer. While powerful, their deterministic recursion can lead to convergence at suboptimal solutions, without escape mechanism. A common workaround relies on task-specific input perturbations at test time combined with answer aggregation via voting. We introduce Probabilistic TRM (PTRM), a task-agnostic framework for test-time compute scaling that addresses this limitation through stochastic exploration. PTRM injects Gaussian noise at each deep recursion step, enabling parallel trajectories to explore diverse solution basins, and selects among them using the model's existing Q head (used for early stopping in the original TRM). Without requiring retraining or task-specific augmentations, PTRM enables substantial accuracy gains across benchmarks, including Sudoku-Extreme (87.4% to 98.75%) and on various puzzles from Pencil Puzzle Bench (62.6% to 91.2%). On the latter, PTRM achieves nearly double the accuracy of frontier LLMs (91.2% vs. 55.1%) at less than 0.0001x the cost, using only 7M parameters.

    中文

    微型递归模型（TRM）通过迭代地优化潜在状态和最终答案，以远少于现代大型语言模型（LLM）的参数解决复杂推理任务。尽管能力强大，其确定性递归可能收敛到次优解，且没有逃离机制。一种常见的变通方法是在测试时针对特定任务扰动输入，再通过投票聚合答案。我们提出概率 TRM（PTRM），这是一种与任务无关的测试时计算扩展框架，通过随机探索解决这一局限。PTRM 在每个深层递归步骤注入高斯噪声，使并行轨迹能够探索不同的解区域，并利用模型现有的 Q 头（原始 TRM 中用于提前停止）从中进行选择。PTRM 无需重新训练或针对特定任务进行数据增强，便能在多个基准上大幅提升准确率，包括 Sudoku-Extreme（从 87.4% 提升至 98.75%）以及 Pencil Puzzle Bench 中的多种谜题（从 62.6% 提升至 91.2%）。在后者上，PTRM 仅使用 7M 个参数，成本不到 0.0001x，却取得了接近前沿 LLM 两倍的准确率（91.2% 对比 55.1%）。

    Andrew Corbett, Archit Sood, Anna Tzatzopoulou, Sai-Aakash Ramesh, Tim Dodwell

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper frames recursive-model inference as approximate inference over latent reasoning trajectories and introduces guided stochastic exploration with trace-based diagnostics, substantially improving puzzle-solving accuracy without retraining. This directly advances inference-time reasoning; its references to internal guides and recursive architectures do not, by themselves, provide mechanistic interpretability or compositional-generalization insight, while the systems connection is secondary.

    本文将递归模型推理视为对潜在推理轨迹的近似推断，并提出带轨迹诊断指标的引导式随机探索，无需重新训练即可显著提升谜题求解准确率。这直接推进了推理时推理能力；文中提及内部引导信号和递归架构，本身并未提供机制可解释性或组合泛化方面的洞见，而系统方面的联系则居于次要地位。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Recent work on recursive architectures has shown that tiny neural networks can be surprisingly powerful on structured reasoning tasks. The trick is to model reasoning trajectories with a latent dynamical system. We argue that the inference-time behaviour of these architectures is best understood as approximate inference over latent reasoning trajectories, with deterministic recursion as the one-particle, zero-noise limit. We make this view operational through guided reasoning: stochastic perturbations of the reasoning dynamics propose neighbouring trajectories, and the model's existing early-stopping head reweights them online. The framework yields three diagnostics computable from inference traces: local stability, guide alignment, with a label-free necessary condition, and cloud-token entropy. These predict whether the procedure will help and which of its outputs to trust. On Sudoku-Extreme it lifts exact-solve accuracy from $85.9\%$ to $98.0\%$ without retraining, and on PPBench, a four-type pencil-puzzle benchmark, from $62.5\%$ to $77.9\%$ with no tuning; on Maze-Hard the diagnostics flag a misaligned guide, as validation performance later confirms. The same machinery thus characterises both when recursive reasoning has room to improve at the trajectory level and when the model's internal guide can recover said improvements. Code is available at `https://github.com/digiLab-ai/bigr`.

    中文

    近期关于递归架构的研究表明，小型神经网络在结构化推理任务上可能具有出色的能力。关键在于用潜在动力系统对推理轨迹进行建模。我们认为，理解这类架构在推理时的行为，最好将其视为对潜在推理轨迹的近似推断，而确定性递归则是单粒子、零噪声的极限情形。我们通过引导推理将这一观点付诸实践：对推理动力学施加随机扰动，提出相邻轨迹；模型已有的提前停止头则在线对这些轨迹重新加权。该框架可从推理轨迹中计算出三种诊断指标：局部稳定性、引导对齐度（含一个无需标签的必要条件）以及云 token 熵。这些指标可以预测该方法是否会有帮助，以及应当信任哪些输出。在 Sudoku-Extreme 上，无需重新训练，精确求解准确率便从$85.9\%$提升至$98.0\%$；在 PPBench（一项包含四类铅笔谜题的基准）上，无需调参，准确率从$62.5\%$提升至$77.9\%$；在 Maze-Hard 上，这些诊断指标则标示出引导信号不对齐，后续验证性能也证实了这一点。因此，同一套方法既能刻画递归推理在轨迹层面何时还有改进空间，也能刻画模型的内部引导信号何时能够找回这些改进。代码见 `https://github.com/digiLab-ai/bigr`。

    Your Agents Are Aging Too: Agent Lifespan Engineering for Deployed Systems

    你的智能体也会老化：面向已部署系统的智能体生命周期工程

    Jianing Zhu, Yeonju Ro, John Robertson, Kevin Wang, Junbo Li, Haris Vikalo, Aditya Akella, Zhangyang Wang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces a longitudinal benchmark and diagnostic probes for how deployed agents’ memory pipelines degrade and recover over time. Its central contribution directly concerns persistent agent memory and system reliability; references to memory stages do not investigate internal model representations.

    本文提出纵向基准和诊断探测方法，用于研究已部署智能体的记忆流水线如何随时间退化和恢复。其核心贡献直接关注持久化智能体记忆和系统可靠性；对记忆阶段的讨论并未探究模型内部表征。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Long-lived AI agents are increasingly deployed as persistent operational systems, yet they are still mostly evaluated like freshly initialized models. Day-one benchmarks miss a basic systems question: how does an agent's reliability change after deployment? Even when model weights are frozen, an agent's effective state keeps changing as it compresses interaction history, retrieves from a growing memory store, revises facts after updates, and undergoes routine maintenance. Reliability therefore becomes a lifespan property of the full agent harness, not only a snapshot property of the base model. We introduce AgingBench, a longitudinal reliability benchmark for agent lifespan engineering: measuring not only whether deployed agents degrade, but what form the degradation takes and where repair should target. AgingBench organizes agent aging into four mechanisms: compression aging, where writing and rewriting drops future-relevant details; interference aging, where accumulated similar memories crowd out the target fact; revision aging, where changed or derived state is not updated correctly; and maintenance aging, where lifecycle events such as model swapping trigger regressions. To diagnose these failures, AgingBench uses temporal dependency graphs and counterfactual probes that produce diagnostic profiles for the write, retrieval, and utilization stages of the memory pipeline. Across 6 scenarios, 10 memory systems and 6 models from two families, we find that agent aging is not one-dimensional over 400 runs spanning 50-200 sessions: a well-formed reply can hide a value the memory no longer supplies; derived state collapses as updates accumulate; and the same wrong answer can require different repairs depending on what the diagnostic profile points to.

    中文

    长期运行的 AI 智能体正越来越多地作为持久化操作系统投入使用，但评估它们时仍大多把它们当作刚初始化的模型。上线首日的基准测试遗漏了一个基本的系统问题：智能体部署后，其可靠性会如何变化？即使模型权重被冻结，智能体的有效状态仍会不断变化：它会压缩交互历史，从不断增长的记忆库中检索信息，在更新后修订事实，并接受日常维护。因此，可靠性是完整智能体运行框架的生命周期属性，而不仅是基础模型在某一时刻的属性。我们提出 AgingBench，这是一项面向智能体生命周期工程的纵向可靠性基准：它不仅衡量已部署智能体是否退化，还衡量退化的形式以及应当将修复工作集中在哪里。AgingBench 将智能体老化归纳为四种机制：压缩老化，即写入和重写时丢失未来有用的细节；干扰老化，即不断积累的相似记忆挤占目标事实；修订老化，即发生变化或推导得出的状态未能得到正确更新；维护老化，即模型切换等生命周期事件引发性能回退。为诊断这些故障，AgingBench 使用时间依赖图和反事实探测，为记忆流水线的写入、检索和使用阶段生成诊断画像。在 6 种场景、10 个记忆系统和来自两个系列的 6 个模型上，我们通过覆盖 50–200 次会话的 400 次运行发现，智能体老化并非单一维度：措辞完整的回复可能掩盖记忆已无法提供某个数值；随着更新不断累积，派生状态会崩溃；而同一个错误答案可能需要不同的修复方式，具体取决于诊断画像所指示的问题。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Generative models, from diffusion models to large language models, achieve remarkable performance but at a cost in training data orders of magnitude larger than what biological learners require. An alternative paradigm has emerged in which networks are trained to predict their own latent representations of related views or masked regions, as in data2vec and JEPA -- an idea related to predictive-coding accounts of the cortex. Despite strong empirical results, the theoretical understanding of these methods remains limited. Central questions include: by how much does latent prediction actually improve data efficiency? Is there a benefit to stacking such methods into multi-scale hierarchies? We answer both using as data a tractable probabilistic context-free grammar that captures the compositional structure of natural language and images. Such a grammar generates strings of visible tokens by recursively applying production rules along a tree of hidden symbols of depth $L$. For such data, supervised or token-level SSL require a number of samples exponential in $L$ to recover the latent tree; we prove that latent prediction achieves this with a number of samples constant in $L$, up to logarithmic factors. We confirm this bound with (i) a hierarchical clustering algorithm, (ii) an end-to-end neural network whose predictor-clusterer modules predict their own latents at each level via gradient descent, and (iii) the first sample-complexity analysis of data2vec, which we show implicitly performs hierarchical latent prediction. This suggests that explicit stacking such as H-JEPA is largely redundant.

    中文

    生成模型，从扩散模型到大型语言模型，取得了显著的性能，但代价是需要的训练数据量比生物学习者所需的高出数个数量级。一种替代范式已经出现：训练网络预测相关视图或掩蔽区域自身的潜在表示，如 data2vec 和 JEPA 中所做的那样——这一思路与皮层的预测编码理论相关。尽管这些方法取得了强有力的实证结果，对它们的理论理解仍然有限。核心问题包括：潜变量预测究竟能在多大程度上提高数据效率？将这类方法堆叠成多尺度层次结构是否有益？我们使用一种可处理的概率上下文无关文法作为数据来回答这两个问题，该文法捕捉自然语言和图像的组合结构。这种文法沿着由深度为$L$的隐藏符号构成的树递归应用产生规则，从而生成可见词元串。对于这类数据，监督学习或词元级自监督学习（SSL）需要数量随$L$呈指数增长的样本才能恢复潜在树；我们证明，潜变量预测只需样本数量对$L$保持常数（忽略对数因子），即可实现这一目标。我们通过以下方式验证这一界限：（i）一种层次聚类算法；（ii）一种端到端神经网络，其预测器—聚类器模块通过梯度下降在每个层级预测自身的潜变量；以及（iii）对 data2vec 的首次样本复杂度分析，我们表明它隐式地执行层次潜变量预测。这表明，像 H-JEPA 这样的显式堆叠在很大程度上是多余的。

    Knowing When to Ask: Segment-Level Credit Assignment for LLM Tool Use

    知道何时求助：LLM 工具使用的分段信用分配

    Abhijit Kumar, Zoey Wu, Mohit Suley

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    CARL uses segment-level reinforcement learning to teach models when tool help is needed, improving problem solving while reducing unnecessary calls. Tool-use organization is a core systems contribution, and training reasoning behavior is a strong contribution; segmentation is only a limited connection to composition.

    CARL 使用分段级强化学习教会模型何时需要工具帮助，在提升问题求解能力的同时减少不必要的调用。工具使用的组织方式是核心系统贡献，推理行为训练也是重要贡献；分段方法与组合性的联系则有限。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Humans know when to reach for help e.g. $347 \times 28$ warrants a calculator while $2+2$ does not. Language models do not. Prompt-based approaches can instruct a model when to invoke tools, but this scaffolding does not teach it to recognize the boundary of its own knowledge. RL approaches that assign a single outcome reward to the whole trajectory fare no better: trajectory-level credit cannot isolate which tool call in a successful episode actually helped, nor penalize unnecessary calls. We propose CARL (Competence-Aware Reinforcement Learning), which trains a critic on the model's own rollouts to learn where parametric knowledge suffices and where it needs external help. By decomposing each rollout at natural tool-use boundaries (e.g., code fence delimiters and context block transitions), CARL assigns independent credit to each segment from a single binary outcome, without external judges or step-level annotations. As a result, erroneous tool calls, incorrect extractions, and unnecessary calls each receive appropriately signed advantages. The trained critic captures the model's domain competence: it separates parametrically solvable from tool-dependent questions with AUC 0.93 at 7B. On five benchmarks spanning arithmetic, multi-hop factual QA, and numerical reasoning over financial tables, CARL improves average exact-match accuracy on the three search benchmarks by 6.7 points at 7B and 9.6 points at 3B over the best RL baseline, with the largest gain (+8.3 EM at 7B, +12.5 EM at 3B) on MuSiQue. At 7B, CARL has a 53% lower tool-use rate than Search-R1 PPO on parametrically answerable questions while remaining 9.8 EM points more accurate on them. Gains are largest at small scale: the 3B improvement is $1.4\times$ the 7B improvement, suggesting that knowing when to ask disproportionately benefits models with smaller parametric memory.

    中文

    人类知道何时该寻求帮助，例如，$347 \times 28$需要计算器，而$2+2$则不需要。语言模型却不知道。基于提示的方法可以指示模型何时调用工具，但这种脚手架并不能教会模型识别自身知识的边界。采用单一结果奖励来评估整条轨迹的 RL 方法也好不到哪里去：轨迹级信用分配既无法区分成功的任务过程中究竟哪次工具调用起了作用，也无法惩罚不必要的调用。我们提出 CARL（能力感知强化学习），它利用模型自身的运行轨迹训练一个评论器，学习哪些问题仅凭参数化知识就能解决，哪些问题需要外部帮助。CARL 在自然的工具使用边界处（例如代码围栏分隔符和上下文块切换）将每条运行轨迹分解成多个片段，并仅凭单一的二元结果为每个片段独立分配信用，无需外部评判者或步骤级标注。因此，错误的工具调用、错误的信息提取和不必要的调用都会得到符号恰当的优势值。训练后的评论器能捕捉模型在特定领域的能力：在 7B 规模下，它区分参数化知识可解的问题与依赖工具的问题，AUC 达到 0.93。在涵盖算术、多跳事实问答以及基于金融表格的数值推理的五个基准上，与最佳 RL 基线相比，CARL 在三个搜索基准上的平均精确匹配准确率在 7B 规模下提升 6.7 个百分点，在 3B 规模下提升 9.6 个百分点；其中 MuSiQue 的增幅最大（7B 下提升 +8.3 EM，3B 下提升 +12.5 EM）。在 7B 规模下，对于参数化知识可回答的问题，CARL 的工具使用率比 Search-R1 PPO 低 53%，同时准确率高出 9.8 个 EM 点。小规模模型的收益最大：3B 模型的提升是 7B 模型提升的$1.4\times$倍，这表明知道何时求助对于参数化记忆较小的模型尤其有益。

    Subliminal Learning Is Steering Vector Distillation

    潜意识学习就是引导向量蒸馏

    Camila Blank, Agam Bhatia, Senthooran Rajamanoharan, Arthur Conmy, Neel Nanda

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper identifies a single activation steering vector as the mechanism for subliminal trait transfer and analyzes how fine-tuning distills that vector. This directly advances internal-mechanism understanding; fine-tuning and optimizer behavior are supporting details, with no substantial composition or reasoning contribution.

    本文将单个激活引导向量识别为潜意识特质迁移的机制，并分析微调如何蒸馏该向量。这直接推进了对内部机制的理解；微调和优化器行为是辅助细节，没有实质性的组合或推理贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Subliminal learning refers to a student language model acquiring a teacher's traits (e.g. a system-prompted preference for owls) when fine-tuned on the teacher's outputs, despite the outputs being semantically unrelated to those traits. It remains poorly understood how data without semantic meaning can transfer specific semantic traits. In this work, we show that subliminal learning is mediated by a single steering vector, i.e. a vector added to the model's activations. Across two open-source models, we find that the teacher's system prompt is well approximated by a steering vector, and that the student's behavior is driven by learning an aligned vector over fine-tuning. System prompts that are not well approximated by steering vectors are not subliminally learned. This is a special case of steering vector distillation, in which a student trained on the outputs of a steered teacher learns to imitate that steering. We demonstrate steering vector distillation on a range of semantic and random vectors. Adding a semantic vector to a model's activations can have both model-independent and model-specific (i.e. non-semantic) effects on its behavior, so generated data that is non-semantic can transmit a vector with semantic effects, enabling subliminal learning. This also explains why subliminal learning does not transfer between models. We find that adaptive optimizers are necessary for subliminal learning in language models: activation gradients on steered data carry a small but consistent component along the steering direction, and non-adaptive optimizers impede this by allowing outlier gradients to dominate.

    中文

    潜意识学习指的是：学生语言模型在教师输出上进行微调后，获得教师的特质（例如，系统提示设定的偏好猫头鹰），尽管这些输出在语义上与该特质无关。语义上没有意义的数据如何传递特定语义特质，目前仍未得到充分理解。在本文中，我们表明，潜意识学习由单个引导向量介导，也就是添加到模型激活值中的一个向量。我们在两个开源模型上发现，教师的系统提示可以通过引导向量很好地近似，而学生的行为则由微调期间学到的对齐向量驱动。无法用引导向量很好近似的系统提示不会被潜意识学得。这是引导向量蒸馏的一种特殊情况：学生在受引导的教师输出上训练后，学会模仿这种引导。我们在一系列语义向量和随机向量上演示了引导向量蒸馏。向模型激活值中添加语义向量，可能对其行为产生模型无关和模型特定（即非语义）的影响，因此，非语义的生成数据也能传递具有语义效果的向量，从而实现潜意识学习。这也解释了潜意识学习为何不会在模型间迁移。我们发现，自适应优化器对于语言模型的潜意识学习是必要的：受引导数据上的激活梯度沿引导方向带有一个微小但一致的分量，而非自适应优化器会让离群梯度占据主导，从而阻碍这一过程。

    An Enigma of Artificial Reason: Investigating the Production-Evaluation Gap in Large Reasoning Models

    人工推理之谜：探究大型推理模型的生成与评估差距

    Mingzhong Sun, Teresa Yeo, Armando Solar-Lezama, Tan Zhi-Xuan

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper investigates why models produce reasoning well but evaluate flawed reasoning poorly, using behavioral evaluation, probes, and causal patching to expose answer-confirmation bias. This directly advances reasoning capability analysis and gives substantial mechanistic evidence about internal representations; compositionality and system design are not addressed.

    本文探究模型为何擅长生成推理，却不擅长评估有缺陷的推理，并通过行为评估、探针和因果补丁揭示答案确认偏差。这直接推进了推理能力分析，并提供了重要的内部表征机制证据；文中未涉及组合性和系统设计。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Studies of human reasoning have shown that people are typically stronger at evaluating reasoning than producing it from scratch. In contrast, large reasoning models (LRMs) are trained to excel at producing long chains of reasoning to solve complex problems. How then do LRMs perform at evaluating reasons? We investigate this with the Valid-Answer-Invalid-Reasoning (VAIR) dataset: math problems and solutions with trivial reasoning flaws but valid answers, designed to isolate reasoning evaluation from the confound of reasoning production. Unlike humans, who we find are only 6% worse at grading than solving such problems, we find a substantial production-evaluation gap in LRMs: frontier models score as low as 52% when evaluating VAIR solutions, despite near-perfect solution production. Why this enigma? Through chain-of-thought (CoT) analysis, we find evidence of an answer confirmation bias: LRMs often produce then check for the correct answer instead of carefully verifying each step, fabricating rationalizations even when noticing anomalous reasoning. Linear probes corroborate this, showing that while LRM activations encode some representation of valid reasoning, they fail to robustly represent VAIR solutions as invalid. Causal patching of the final answer's representations causes LRM verdicts and activations to flip at substantial rates, demonstrating that answer validity is a causal factor in models' confirmation biases. These findings indicate an outstanding limitation in dominant approaches to reasoning training, which incentivize LRMs to produce and confirm reasoning towards correct answers, but not to robustly evaluate the underlying reasons

    中文

    人类推理研究表明，人们评估推理的能力通常强于从头生成推理的能力。与之相反，大型推理模型（LRM）接受训练，擅长生成长篇推理链来解决复杂问题。那么，LRM 评估理由的表现如何？我们使用 Valid-Answer-Invalid-Reasoning（VAIR）数据集进行研究：该数据集包含数学问题及其解答，答案正确但推理中有细微瑕疵，旨在将推理评估与推理生成这一混杂因素区分开来。我们发现，人类在给这类问题评分时仅比自己解题的表现差 6%；而 LRM 则存在显著的生成-评估差距：前沿模型评估 VAIR 解答时的得分低至 52%，尽管它们生成解答时的表现近乎完美。 这一谜团从何而来？通过思维链（CoT）分析，我们发现了答案确认偏差的证据：LRM 往往先生成答案再检查答案是否正确，而不是仔细验证每一步；即使注意到推理存在异常，也会编造理由加以合理化。线性探针进一步证实了这一点：尽管 LRM 激活值编码了对有效推理的一些表征，但它们无法稳健地将 VAIR 解答表征为无效。对最终答案表征进行因果补丁，会以相当高的比例使 LRM 的判断和激活值翻转，表明答案正确性是模型确认偏差的一个因果因素。这些发现揭示了主流推理训练方法的一项突出局限：这些方法鼓励 LRM 生成推理并确认正确答案，却没有鼓励模型稳健地评估其底层理由。

    Geometric Latent Reasoning Induces Shorter Generations in LLMs

    几何潜在推理使 LLM 生成更短

    Shashi Kumar, Yacouba Kaloga, Petr Motlicek, Ina Kodrasi, Andrea Cavallaro

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces geometric latent reasoning, training a transition head to approximate reasoning trajectories and reduce generation length while preserving problem solving. This is a core contribution to latent reasoning; embedding geometry and iterative computation create incidental links to interpretability and systems, but the abstract does not claim insights into internal representation mechanisms or broader system organization.

    本文提出几何潜在推理，训练转移头来近似推理轨迹，在保持问题求解能力的同时缩短生成长度。这是对潜在推理的核心贡献；嵌入几何和迭代计算与可解释性和系统有附带联系，但摘要并未声称揭示内部表征机制或更广泛的系统组织。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language models solve complex problems by generating lengthy chains of explicit reasoning tokens. While effective, this makes reasoning expensive, length-sensitive, and constrained to (discrete) natural language. While latent reasoning offers a continuous alternative, determining useful structures for intermediate latent states is an open challenge. In this paper, we formulate latent reasoning as a geometric path-approximation problem within the model's pretrained token-embedding space. We introduce Geometric Latent Reasoning (GLR), which uses a lightweight transition head to predict iterative direction updates in embedding space. Using textual chain-of-thought traces as anchors, GLR learns to approximate discrete reasoning trajectories while permitting continuous deviations from exact token embeddings. Evaluations on mathematical reasoning benchmarks using Qwen3 models reveal an emergent phenomenon: geometric latent reasoning induces substantially shorter generations without an explicit length objective. By replacing early explicit reasoning with continuous latent steps, models often reach correct answers using substantially fewer total generation steps. These findings suggest that continuous trajectories act as compact intermediate reasoning states, exposing a new tradeoff between latent computation budget, output length, and accuracy. Our code is publicly available at: https://github.com/idiap/GLR. The project page is available at: https://glr-llm.github.io/.

    中文

    大型语言模型通过生成冗长的显式推理 token 链来解决复杂问题。虽然这种方法有效，但会使推理成本高、对长度敏感，并受限于（离散的）自然语言。潜在推理提供了一种连续替代方案，但如何为中间潜在状态确定有用的结构仍是一个开放问题。本文将潜在推理形式化为模型预训练 token 嵌入空间中的几何路径近似问题。我们提出几何潜在推理（GLR），使用轻量级转移头预测嵌入空间中的迭代方向更新。GLR 以文本思维链轨迹为锚点，学习近似离散推理轨迹，同时允许偏离精确 token 嵌入的连续变化。使用 Qwen3 模型在数学推理基准上进行评估，结果揭示了一种涌现现象：无需显式的长度目标，几何潜在推理便能显著缩短生成长度。通过用连续潜在步骤替代早期的显式推理，模型往往能够以显著更少的总生成步骤得出正确答案。这些发现表明，连续轨迹能够充当紧凑的中间推理状态，揭示潜在计算预算、输出长度和准确率之间的新权衡。我们的代码公开发布于：https://github.com/idiap/GLR。项目页面见：https://glr-llm.github.io/。

    MOSAIC: Efficient Mixture-of-Agent Scheduling via Adaptive Aggregation and Inference Concurrency

    MOSAIC：通过自适应聚合与推理并发实现高效的智能体混合调度

    Saptarshi Mitra, Yifan Zhang, Rachid Karami, Sreetama Sarkar, Phyo Pyae Moe Aung, Nazmul Takbir, Souvik Kundu, Sitao Huang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    MOSAIC contributes workload-aware expert placement and query scheduling, plus confidence-based aggregation, to improve MoA throughput under limited GPU resources. Reasoning is only the workload context; the stated contribution is system organization and execution efficiency.

    MOSAIC 通过工作负载感知的专家放置和查询调度，以及基于置信度的聚合，提升有限 GPU 资源下的 MoA 吞吐量。推理只是工作负载背景；论文所述贡献在于系统组织和执行效率。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Mixture-of-Agents (MoA) systems improve reasoning accuracy by routing each query to multiple expert LLMs and aggregating their outputs. Efficiently executing this workload on limited GPU resources has bottlenecks. Skill-based routing creates skewed expert demand, and combining instruction-tuned LLMs with long-reasoning models results in extreme variability in generation lengths. Consequently, traditional scheduling strategies suffer from significant GPU idling and throughput collapse due to load imbalances. We present MOSAIC, a scheduling framework for accelerating batch-oriented MoA workloads. MOSAIC uses two-stage workload-aware scheduling: an expert placement stage, where an integer linear program (ILP) decides expert placement, followed by a query-sequencing stage that schedules requests based on predicted output lengths. Additionally, MOSAIC uses confidence-aware adaptive aggregation, leveraging inter-expert agreement to bypass the heavy aggregator LLM for consensus queries. On a 4-GPU system, MOSAIC achieves 2.7-3.4x end-to-end speedups over round-robin scheduling and reduces the mean time-to-answer by 3.9-7.8x, while matching accuracy within +/-1pp.

    中文

    智能体混合（Mixture-of-Agents，MoA）系统通过将每个查询路由到多个专家 LLM 并聚合其输出，提升推理准确率。在有限的 GPU 资源上高效执行这类工作负载存在瓶颈。基于技能的路由会造成专家需求不均，而将指令微调 LLM 与长推理模型结合，会导致生成长度出现极大差异。因此，传统调度策略会因负载不均而造成显著的 GPU 空闲和吞吐量崩溃。我们提出 MOSAIC，这是一种用于加速面向批处理的 MoA 工作负载的调度框架。MOSAIC 采用两阶段的工作负载感知调度：首先是专家放置阶段，由整数线性规划（ILP）决定专家的放置位置；随后是查询排序阶段，根据预测的输出长度调度请求。此外，MOSAIC 采用置信度感知的自适应聚合，利用专家间的一致性，对达成共识的查询绕过计算开销较大的聚合器 LLM。在一个 4-GPU 系统上，与轮询调度相比，MOSAIC 实现了 2.7-3.4 倍的端到端加速，并将平均回答时间缩短了 3.9-7.8 倍，同时准确率保持在相差 +/-1pp 以内。

    Hint-Guided Diversified Policy Optimization for LLM Reasoning

    面向 LLM 推理的提示引导多样化策略优化

    Zhiyu Cao, Kaixin Wu, Mingjie Zhong, Peifeng Li, Can Ye, Qiaoming Zhu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    HDPO trains LLMs to propose diverse solution outlines, select a reliable candidate, and then reason further, using structured cold-start training and reinforcement learning. This directly targets reasoning capability development; candidate diversity alone does not establish a substantive compositional contribution.

    HDPO 使用结构化冷启动训练和强化学习，使 LLM 提出多样的解法提纲、选择可靠的候选解法，然后继续推理。这直接针对推理能力的发展；仅有候选解法多样性不足以证明存在实质性的组合贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Recent developments in Large Language Models (LLMs) have showcased impressive reasoning capabilities, with Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) being a promising enhancement strategy. However, existing reward mechanisms are constrained to the outcome-level correctness and lack explicit signals to guide the model to consider diverse solutions. In contrast, human problem solving typically involves evaluating multiple potential approaches and selecting the most reliable solution, a cognitive process that current RLVR frameworks do not explicitly incentivize. Inspired by this, we propose Hint-Guided Diversified Policy Optimization (HDPO), allowing the model to first list all potential candidate solution outlines as hints and then select the most reliable one for further reasoning. HDPO comprises two stages of Cold Start for Structured Reasoning and Hint-Guided Diversified Reinforcement Learning to incentivize the model to generate diverse and reliable solutions following the ``propose-select-think'' trajectory. Experimental results show that HDPO effectively boosts LLM reasoning and enhances the diversity of candidate solutions as well as the LLM's ability to identify reliable solutions.

    ENGLISH

    Audio-language models (ALMs) often follow text that conflicts with audio, even when the audio evidence is clear. This raises a basic question: is the audio-supported answer unavailable, or is it represented but overridden by the conflicting text? We examine this question using a same-audio counterfactual that keeps the audio fixed, removes only the conflicting text, and measures the resulting shift in model preference. Across five ALMs and four conflict tasks, 64.1% of conflict samples show a sign flip: the same-audio branch prefers the audio-supported answer, whereas the joint branch prefers the text-supported answer. This pattern suggests that the relevant audio evidence is encoded but loses in arbitration. Activation patching further localizes the reversal to answer-position computation, and patching effects closely track output candidate-score differences (Spearman rho=0.93). Using this diagnostic, we propose Gated Audio Counterfactual Logit Correction (GACL), a training-free decoding rule that interpolates between joint and same-audio scores. Under a strict 5 pp faithfulness-drop budget, GACL improves nAUC by 17.8 points over the best contrastive baseline and transfers without retuning to vision-text arbitration (up to +40.5 pp).

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper’s main contribution is an empirical benchmark and comparison showing that explicit execution invariants secure tool-connected agent runtimes across centralized and gateway designs.     论文的主要贡献是一项实证基准测试与比较，表明明确的执行不变量能够保障集中式和网关式工具连接智能体运行时的安全。这些安全机制和智能体运行时架构直接推进了系统方向；工作流组合只是附带内容，对其他方向没有实质贡献。

    ENGLISH

    Tool-connected agents need execution-time invariants that hold even when a model follows an adversarial instruction. We formulate eight execution-layer invariants (I1-I8) covering structured authority, canonical resource resolution, principal and delegation binding, handle lifecycle, explicit source-to-target transfer, request-correlated denial evidence, and single-use approval state. To test whether these protections require a centralized runtime or follow from the invariants themselves, we compare HCP, an in-memory runtime with managed handles and tasks, against an independent gateway/server ACL (B3) enforcing the same I1-I8 contract over identical grants and labels. Both block 18 modeled violations and complete 25 workflows, while 16 source-code ablations pinpoint the checks responsible. Outside our scripted corpus, we test three boundaries. First, on 24 held-out AgentDojo tasks with live models, DeepSeek reaches attacker goals in 4 direct sessions while both controllers deny every attacker call; however, strict reference-derived grants also deny 40 non-attacker calls, and first-divergence replay under an approve-all control reaches 4 new attacker goals. Second, across 132 conditions on unmodified ChainCaps and Playwright MCP servers, per-call grants block ungranted writes but cannot stop a secret passed as an ordinary argument to an authorized sink; session source budgets block that copy but refuse unrelated actions; and explicit handle pipes or sealed reads block handle-mediated exfiltration while preserving unrelated workflows. Third, on a matched MCP backend, HCP adds 0.13 ms per workflow outside MCP calls while retaining 7.7 MB of state over one thousand workflows versus 0.7 MB for B3. Identical decisions across HCP and B3 show that enforcing explicit I1-I8 invariants at controlled entrances secures tool execution across centralized and gateway designs.

    Arun Vignesh Malarkkan, Manan Roy Choudhury, Utkarsh Byahut, Yash Ravindra Charde, Vivek Gupta, Xiquan Cui, Xiangliang Zhang and Yanjie Fu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由
