    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Firepool introduces a production GPU-job broker using caller-specific pod reuse, fractional-GPU standby capacity, and queue-driven budgets, with measured latency and capacity gains for agent and RL workloads. Its contribution directly advances agent execution and compute allocation; reasoning is only workload context, and no reasoning method is studied.

    Firepool 为生产环境引入了一种 GPU 作业代理，通过调用者专属的 pod 复用、分数 GPU 待命容量和队列驱动的预算，为智能体和 RL 工作负载带来了经测量验证的延迟与容量收益。其贡献直接推进了智能体执行和计算资源分配；推理只是工作负载背景，本文未研究推理方法。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    AI agents and reinforcement-learning (RL) trainers run thousands of short, isolated GPU jobs: tool calls, verifiers, and rollouts. A job often finishes in seconds, but starting a GPU pod for it takes 20-35 s even when the container image is already on the node, and minutes when it is not. A warm pod removes the wait only if it can serve the next job, and keeping pods warm must neither waste GPUs nor leak state between callers. Firepool, the sandbox and execution broker behind agentic and RL workloads at LinkedIn, meets both requirements. It makes pods interchangeable by building them from a shared base image per hardware profile and binding each job's code, extra dependencies, and cluster topology when the job starts. It keeps them warm cheaply and safely by reusing a pod only for the caller that used it last, staging zero-VRAM standby pods in fractional GPU shares alongside active pods, and capping the GPUs that warm pools may hold via queue-driven budgets. Over a sampled peak period in production, Firepool serves 94.7% of 3,206 pod requests from warm or standby capacity. In paired benchmarks with fixed-duration jobs on production H200 nodes, agent and RL loops finish 13x and 10.8x faster than with a fresh pod per job; against a fresh reuse tag per job, warm reuse cuts p90 start latency from 59.1 s to 3.5 s. When a job cannot reuse the previous pod, standby promotion shortens the handover wait from 51 s to 0.94 s. In local and simulated runs, a keep-alive matched to the loop's pauses keeps the latency benefit while holding about half the capacity of an always-on pool.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Reasoning in large language models can be disrupted by simple input perturbations (e.g. adding irrelevant distractors), suggesting reliance on spurious correlations. Identifying and suppressing the spurious features involved in long chain-of-thought reasoning remains challenging. We introduce Spurious-feature WEight EdiTing (SWEET), a training-free method that combines counterfactual interventions with mechanistic interpretability to identify and suppress spurious-features. SWEET extracts token- and sequence-level behavioral directions from activation contrasts between original problems and their counterfactual variants - capturing local and global patterns of spurious reasoning. It then localizes the responsible MLP neurons and attention heads and suppresses their contributions along these directions through weight edits. Using only 20 original-counterfactual pairs for direction extraction, SWEET improves accuracy by an average of 11.8 percentage points on perturbed inputs and 2 points on original inputs across five open-weight reasoning models and five reasoning benchmarks. It also reduces the relative gap between original and perturbed accuracies from 17.6% to 2.5%. Analyses identify two recurring forms of spurious reasoning, i.e. over-integrating irrelevant conditions and overthinking, and provide mechanistic evidence that SWEET improves reasoning robustness by suppressing both behavioral directions.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper directly links internal feature organization and representation geometry to catastrophic forgetting, and tests whether unified, factored representations preserve behavior under fine-tuning. The focus is mechanistic representation quality; fine-tuning and forgetting do not establish a substantive connection to reasoning or compositional generalization.

    本文直接将内部特征组织和表征几何与灾难性遗忘联系起来，并检验统一的因子化表征能否在微调过程中保持行为。其重点是表征质量的机制性研究；微调和遗忘并未建立与推理或组合泛化的实质性联系。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    This paper explores an unexpected connection between the quality of a neural network's (NN's) internal representation and its vulnerability to catastrophic forgetting. The representational forgetting hypothesis is that networks with unified, factored representation (UFR) can resist catastrophic forgetting without any modification to the underlying fine-tuning algorithm or network architecture. The key insight is that catastrophic forgetting may largely result from fractured entangled representation (FER): fine-tuning on only part of the input domain results in disruptive changes for other input patterns, because of how individual features are globally entangled. In contrast, if a gradient update is compatible with how a UFR network factors its representation, such an update may result in coordinated change across the input domain, alleviating catastrophic forgetting. Experiments in two domains provide evidence for this hypothesis: (1) an illustrative 1D regression task, in which UFR networks constructed by hand are compared against networks trained from scratch with SGD, and (2) an image-regression task with NNs previously shown to exhibit UFR. In both settings, UFR networks forget substantially less than their FER counterparts when repeatedly fine-tuned on UFR-compatible variations. Further experiments show that a training loss that distills UFR representations into fresh NNs reduces forgetting; along with several additional controls, these results help isolate representation as the critical factor. Together these results suggest that representational quality is an underappreciated contributor to catastrophic forgetting, and that the encouragement and maintenance of such quality may require attending to what patterns a particular NN is ready to learn.

    本文探讨了神经网络（NN）内部表征的质量与其易受灾难性遗忘影响之间一种出人意料的联系。表征遗忘假说认为，具有统一因子化表征（UFR）的网络无需修改底层微调算法或网络架构，就能抵御灾难性遗忘。关键洞见是，灾难性遗忘可能主要源于破碎纠缠表征（FER）：由于各个特征在整体上相互纠缠，仅在输入域的一部分上微调，就会对其他输入模式造成破坏性变化。相比之下，如果梯度更新与 UFR 网络对其表征进行因子化的方式相兼容，那么这种更新可能会在整个输入域中产生协调一致的变化，从而缓解灾难性遗忘。两个领域的实验为这一假说提供了证据：（1）一个示例性的 1D 回归任务，其中将手工构造的 UFR 网络与通过 SGD 从头训练的网络进行比较；（2）一个图像回归任务，使用此前已证明具有 UFR 的 NN。在这两种设置中，当网络反复针对与 UFR 兼容的变化进行微调时，UFR 网络的遗忘程度都远低于其 FER 对照网络。进一步实验表明，将 UFR 表征蒸馏到全新 NN 中的训练损失能够减少遗忘；结合若干额外控制实验，这些结果有助于确定表征是关键因素。总之，这些结果表明，表征质量是一个被低估的灾难性遗忘成因，而要鼓励并维持这种质量，可能需要关注特定 NN 已准备好学习哪些模式。

    Reasoning models often continue generating after producing an answer, yet stopping prematurely may interrupt useful verification or revision. In this work, we investigate whether targeted interventions in a model's internal computation can provide a reliable signal for when to stop reasoning. We introduce Prune-to-Probe, an inference-time controller that uses causal activation interventions to probe the stability of a model's current answer. Specifically, we identify late-MLP coordinates that contribute to post-answer continuation while excluding those important for answer completion. Once an answer is stated, Prune-to-Probe temporarily suppresses the selected coordinates and measures the resulting stopping response relative to matched random interventions. Crucially, these interventions serve only as probes: the model either returns its existing answer or resumes generation from an untouched cache. These results demonstrate the potential of causal activation probes for efficient inference-time control without permanent model modification.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Does reinforcement learning teach language models new capabilities, or merely amplify ones acquired during pre-training? The literature offers evidence for both: pass@$k$ studies suggest RL reweights latent behaviours while some controlled composition studies demonstrate gains beyond simple amplification. We argue that this question has no answer independent of the capability state of the base model, and propose a two-dimensional state space for post-trainability. The first axis, \emph{effective full-solution support}, measures whether successful trajectories can be sampled under a feasible exploration budget. The second axis, \emph{atomic primitive coverage}, measures whether the constituent skills of a solution can be executed when the burden of composition is removed. Together, these dimensions motivate three regimes -- amplification, composition-limited, and acquisition-limited -- each predicting a distinct empirical signature and calling for a distinct intervention. We propose a prospective measurement protocol and investigate the framework using synthetic composition tasks across three small language models. We find that primitive mastery alone does not guarantee that RL can learn a composition. Checkpoints that execute every primitive reliably can fail to improve when complete solutions are never sampled during training, whereas modest composition supervision that establishes nonzero support enables substantial RL gains. The framework reframes mid-training as preparation for post-training: its role is to move models into states from which RL can operate effectively.

    Offloading model state to host memory and streaming layer weights let a single multi-GPU node train large mixture-of-experts (MoE) models. GPU memory then becomes a performance budget, shared by resident expert state, retained activations, and execution worksets. The best allocation depends on the expert execution path, batch size, and sequence length. For expert-parallel execution, OOM updates resident experts on their owning GPUs and jointly plans state residency and MoE activation retention according to pipeline dependencies. For local execution, OOM bounds GPU worksets through dependency-aware partitioning; in hybrid models, it also retains attention results on the host to avoid costly recomputation and selectively regenerates layer boundaries through cheaper layers to make room. Calibrated cost models guide joint configuration within GPU and host budgets to minimize step time; OOM selects among the configured paths through short executions. On four H100s, OOM trains with 1M-token contexts, whereas FSDP2, ZeRO-Offload, and MegaTrain exhaust GPU memory at 512K. It also trains a 122B-parameter MoE model, on which all three exhaust host memory. On four 24 GB RTX 4090s, it trains 512K-token contexts and 1,024 1K-token sequences per step without gradient accumulation. Across matched-global-batch comparisons, OOM delivers 1.58x and 4.08x geometric-mean (up to 2.14x and 7.77x) throughput over CPU-offloaded FSDP2 on the two platforms while using the least host memory among the evaluated systems -- as little as 1/3.0 of FSDP2's.

    将模型状态卸载到主机内存并以流式方式传输层权重，使单个多 GPU 节点能够训练大型混合专家（MoE）模型。此时，GPU 内存成为一项性能预算，由驻留的专家状态、保留的激活和执行工作集共同使用。最佳分配取决于专家执行路径、批次大小和序列长度。我们提出 OOM（Offload-Optimized MoE），这是一种 MoE 全参数训练系统，对专家执行和内存分配进行协同设计。对于专家并行执行，OOM 会在各专家所属的 GPU 上更新驻留专家，并根据流水线依赖关系联合规划状态驻留和 MoE 激活保留。对于本地执行，OOM 通过考虑依赖关系的分区来限制 GPU 工作集；对于混合模型，它还会将注意力结果保留在主机上，以避免代价高昂的重新计算，并选择性地通过计算成本较低的层重新生成层边界，为其他内容腾出空间。经过校准的成本模型会在 GPU 和主机预算内指导联合配置，以最小化步时；OOM 通过短时执行在已配置的路径中进行选择。在四张 H100 上，OOM 可以使用 1M token 的上下文进行训练，而 FSDP2、ZeRO-Offload 和 MegaTrain 在 512K 时就耗尽 GPU 内存。OOM 还可训练一个 122B 参数的 MoE 模型，而其他三种系统都会耗尽主机内存。在四张 24 GB RTX 4090 上，它无需梯度累积即可训练 512K token 的上下文，并在每步处理 1,024 个长度为 1K token 的序列。在全局批次大小匹配的比较中，相比使用 CPU 卸载的 FSDP2，OOM 在两种平台上实现了 1.58x 和 4.08x 的几何平均吞吐量提升（最高分别为 2.14x 和 7.77x），同时在所评估的系统中使用的主机内存最少——最低仅为 FSDP2 的 1/3.0。

    D3Tree: Learning to Prune Block-Diffusion Draft Trees for Efficient Verification

    D3Tree：学习剪枝块扩散草稿树，以实现高效验证

    Hong Nie, Zhangchi Gao, Jun Yu, Bo Wang, Jianqing Sun and Shengping Liu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    D3Tree learns to prune speculative decoding trees using predicted node survival and adapts verification budgets to serving load, a core contribution to computation allocation and efficient model serving. Tree-structured candidate composition and improved decoding are relevant to compositionality and reasoning, but the abstract focuses on inference efficiency rather than systematic generalization or reasoning mechanisms.

    D3Tree 学习利用预测的节点存续概率剪枝推测解码树，并根据服务负载调整验证预算，这是对计算分配和高效模型服务的核心贡献。树状候选组合和解码改进与组合性及推理相关，但摘要聚焦于推理效率，而非系统性泛化或推理机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Block-diffusion drafters propose a whole block of tokens in one forward pass, and draft trees built from their position-wise marginals increase the expected accepted length of speculative decoding. Every tree node occupies a query row in target verification, so under concurrent serving low-yield branches compete with other requests for verification capacity. Existing tree methods select verified nodes by draft probability under a fixed or cost-selected per-request budget, and thus always retain a prefix of the drafter's ranking. We present D3Tree, which learns which nodes of a block-diffusion draft tree are worth verifying. A tree-size head with 2H+2 parameters predicts each candidate's conditional survival from the draft state, the candidate embedding, and its draft log-probability. Thresholding the product of these scores along parent chains yields an ancestor-closed subtree whose size adapts to each request and decoding round. The head is trained on a frozen drafter with conditional labels on the full candidate tree; an optional joint mode also steers the drafter toward the retained reference path. At serving time, D3Tree verifies whole trees under light load and, under heavy load, allocates one batch-wide node budget by predicted survival, sized to the target's matrix-multiplication tiles. Retained trees share one ancestor-masked target pass, while construction, pruning, and scheduling run on the GPU and overlap with the host. Across six vision-language verifiers and 17 text and multimodal benchmarks, D3Tree is fastest in 70 of 72 load settings, with 3.2-4.0x speedup over autoregressive decoding for one request and 1.3-1.8x at 64 concurrent requests, where fixed-budget trees fall below autoregressive speed. Under a time-varying arrival trace, it has the lowest mean end-to-end latency in every arrival phase.

    中文

    块扩散起草器通过一次前向传播提出一整块 token；根据其位置边缘分布构建的草稿树能够提高推测解码的预期接受长度。目标模型验证时，每个树节点都会占用一个查询行，因此在并发服务场景下，低收益分支会与其他请求争夺验证容量。现有树方法按照草稿概率，在固定的或按成本选定的每请求预算下选择待验证节点，因此总是保留起草器排序中的一个前缀。我们提出 D3Tree，它能够学习块扩散草稿树中哪些节点值得验证。一个含有 2H+2 个参数的树大小预测头，根据草稿状态、候选项嵌入及其草稿对数概率，预测每个候选项的条件存续概率。沿父节点链对这些分数的乘积进行阈值筛选，会得到一个祖先闭合子树，其大小会随每个请求和解码轮次而变化。该预测头在冻结的起草器上训练，使用完整候选树上的条件标签；可选的联合模式还会引导起草器趋向保留的参考路径。在服务时，负载较轻时 D3Tree 会验证整棵树；负载较重时，则依据预测存续概率分配一个批次范围内的节点预算，并使其适配目标模型的矩阵乘法分块。保留的树共享一次应用祖先掩码的目标模型前向传播，而树的构建、剪枝和调度均在 GPU 上运行，并与主机端工作重叠。在六个视觉语言验证模型和 17 个文本及多模态基准上，D3Tree 在 72 种负载设置中的 70 种下速度最快；相比自回归解码，单请求时加速 3.2-4.0x，64 个并发请求时加速 1.3-1.8x，而固定预算树在此时的速度低于自回归解码。在随时间变化的到达轨迹下，它在每个到达阶段的平均端到端延迟都最低。

    Vitus Benson, Fanny Yang, Markus Reichstein

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The central contribution is a sparse-autoencoder method and evaluation protocol for decomposing Earth-observation embeddings, with evidence about feature alignment, spatial scale, and what properties arise from sparsity versus learned dictionaries. This directly advances representation interpretability; the applications are demonstrations rather than composition, reasoning, or system-design contributions.

    核心贡献是使用稀疏自编码器分解地球观测嵌入的方法和评估方案，并提供关于特征对齐、空间尺度，以及哪些性质源于稀疏性而非学习所得字典的证据。这直接推进了表征可解释性；相关应用属于演示，并未构成组合、推理或系统设计方面的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Earth observation foundation models produce global metre-resolution embeddings that underpin work across agriculture, ecology, hydrology, and beyond. Yet these embeddings are opaque: each dimension entangles unrelated physical concepts, which makes them difficult to interpret and their robustness hard to assess. Here, we propose sparse autoencoders (SAEs) as a principled way to decompose Earth embeddings into sparse, approximately monosemantic features over an overcomplete dictionary. Because LLM judges of interpretations do not transfer to satellite pixels, and spatial autocorrelation matters, we introduce a tailored evaluation protocol. It scores any SAE on reconstruction at matched sparsity, alignment with reference concepts, and spatial scale, each against baselines that include an SAE whose decoder is a frozen random dictionary. On this protocol, SAEs reconstruct AlphaEarth and Tessera embeddings better than every baseline at matched sparsity. Their features align with far fewer reference concepts than raw embedding dimensions (on AlphaEarth, 88% align with at most one of 20 concept groups, most with none, against a median of 12 per raw dimension). They also carry more of their variance at fine spatial scales (23 to 32% within a 640 m patch for BatchTopK and Matryoshka, against 9%). An SAE with a frozen random decoder shares both properties, which therefore follow from sparsity, whereas only a learned dictionary reconstructs the embedding accurately: on AlphaEarth, trained SAEs leave eight times less variance unexplained. We test the sparse code on two applications, discovering land-cover sub-concepts and detecting out-of-distribution pixels by area-of-applicability estimation. Both indicate how sparse features could be used, but neither is yet reliable enough for practical use. Together, these results are a step toward Earth observation models whose features can be inspected.

    中文

    地球观测基础模型能够生成全球范围、米级分辨率的嵌入，为农业、生态学、水文学等领域的研究提供基础。然而，这些嵌入是不透明的：每个维度都纠缠着互不相关的物理概念，因此难以解释，也难以评估其鲁棒性。在此，我们提出将稀疏自编码器（SAE）作为一种有原则的方法，通过过完备字典将地球嵌入分解为稀疏且近似单义的特征。由于由 LLM 充当的解释评判器不能直接用于卫星像素，而且空间自相关也很重要，我们设计了一套专门的评估方案。该方案从相同稀疏度下的重构、与参考概念的对齐程度以及空间尺度三个方面对任意 SAE 评分；每项评分都与多个基线进行比较，其中包括解码器为冻结随机字典的 SAE。根据该方案，在相同稀疏度下，SAE 对 AlphaEarth 和 Tessera 嵌入的重构效果优于所有基线。与原始嵌入维度相比，SAE 特征对应的参考概念少得多（在 AlphaEarth 上，88% 的特征至多与 20 个概念组中的一个对齐，其中多数与任何概念组都不对应；而原始维度对应数量的中位数为 12）。这些特征在精细空间尺度上承载的方差也更多（BatchTopK 和 Matryoshka 在 640 m 区块内占 23% 至 32%，而对照为 9%）。具有冻结随机解码器的 SAE 也具备这两种性质，因此它们源于稀疏性；而只有学习得到的字典才能准确重构嵌入：在 AlphaEarth 上，训练后的 SAE 未解释的方差少了八倍。我们在两项应用中测试了稀疏编码：发现土地覆盖的子概念，并通过适用范围估计检测分布外像素。两项应用都展示了稀疏特征的潜在用途，但目前都还不够可靠，无法实际使用。总之，这些结果是迈向特征可供检查的地球观测模型的一步。

    本文提出一种具身智能体方法，根据训练回合迭代完善有界文本记忆，并展示了该方法在不同模型间的迁移能力以及对未见场景的泛化能力。记忆和智能体组织是其核心贡献；泛化和流程恢复与组合及推理有部分关联，但摘要并未研究内部机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Recent studies of embodied agents based on frontier multimodal large language models (MLLMs) develop harness engineering around the MLLM, such as harnesses with post-trained policies and recursive self-improvement loops. Yet whether these additions exceed the native capability of the MLLM remains unexplored. We introduce SimplEvo to explore how far an MLLM can improve under direct control when it retains its execution experience in self-written text memories. It requires no weight updates, post-trained policies, or privileged information. The MLLM writes a coordinate-free task memory once from a single demonstration. Under a strict train-test protocol, it then creates a bounded working memory on training episodes only and refines it after each episode with lessons on procedure, completion, and recovery. Both memories stay fixed at test time. On EBench, SimplEvo lifts the success rate (SR) of GPT-6-Astra under direct control from 46.7% to 81.7%, and tops the RoboDojo leaderboard with 69.63% SR and a score of 75.32. Compared with memories that also store past visual frames, SimplEvo reaches a similar SR with text memory alone while using fewer tokens. With its memories fixed, SimplEvo also generalizes to unseen layouts and randomized scene configurations. Moreover, the working memory transfers across models: written by GPT-6-Astra, it can be reused as is by weaker MLLMs and improve their performance without any adaptation of their own.

    中文

    近期研究围绕前沿多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）构建具身智能体，发展了多种配套工程方案，例如搭配后训练策略的方案以及递归自我改进循环。然而，这些新增机制是否超越了 MLLM 的原生能力，仍未得到探索。我们提出 SimplEvo，以研究在直接控制下，MLLM 将执行经验保存在自己撰写的文本记忆中时，能力能够提升多少。它不需要权重更新、后训练策略或特权信息。MLLM 根据一次演示，仅撰写一次与坐标无关的任务记忆。在严格的训练—测试协议下，它随后仅利用训练回合创建有界工作记忆，并在每个回合后根据流程、完成情况和恢复策略方面的经验加以完善。两种记忆在测试时都保持固定。在 EBench 上，SimplEvo 将 GPT-6-Astra 在直接控制下的成功率（SR）从 46.7% 提高到 81.7%，并以 69.63% 的 SR 和 75.32 的得分位列 RoboDojo 排行榜第一。与同时存储过去视觉帧的记忆相比，SimplEvo 仅使用文本记忆，就达到了相近的 SR，同时使用更少的 token。记忆固定后，SimplEvo 还能泛化到未见过的布局和随机化的场景配置。此外，工作记忆可跨模型迁移：由 GPT-6-Astra 编写后，较弱的 MLLM 可以直接复用，无需自身进行任何适配，便能提升性能。

    Payman Behnam, Debopam Sanyal, Pranav Ponnusamy, Kusum Meda Ravi, Pranav Sastry, Mani Chandana Bandaru, Alind Khare, Myungjin Lee, Alexey Tumanov

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    BridgeKV introduces a learned cache translation module that lets a larger model handle prefill while a smaller one decodes, improving inference speed and energy use across evaluated settings. Its cache mapping gives limited representation-related insight, while the central contribution directly advances model computation and serving systems; following next-token predictions is not itself a reasoning contribution.

    BridgeKV 提出一个学习式缓存转换模块，使大模型负责预填充、小模型负责解码，从而在所评估的设置中提升推理速度并降低能耗。其缓存映射提供了有限的表征相关见解，而核心贡献直接推进了模型计算和服务系统；遵循下一 token 预测本身并不构成推理贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    LLM inference has two phases with different bottlenecks: LLM prefill runs once per request and is compute-intensive. Decoding repeats for every output token and is limited by memory bandwidth. To address the challenges associated with this issue, different solutions have been proposed. All of these solutions use the same model for both prefill and decode phases. We propose BridgeKV, which uses a larger model for prefill and a smaller model of the same family for decoding. A lightweight KV-stitching module translates the larger model's prompt cache into the smaller model's cache layout. It handles differences in cache shape and representation through learned local layer mixing and separate nonlinear maps for keys and values. With both models frozen, we train the module to align their caches and make the smaller model follow the larger model's next-token predictions. A second training stage adds low-rank adapters when further task adaptation is needed. Across six model pairs and five datasets, BridgeKV outperforms fine-tuned small-model baselines with matched trainable parameter budgets in all 30 settings. It closes up to 80% of the quality gap to using the larger model for both phases. On one A40 GPU, Llama-3.1-Instruct-8B to Llama-3.2-Instruct-1B achieves 3.0X faster requests than the larger model alone, with latency close to the smaller model alone. BridgeKV can improve the hardware and system solutions that separate prefill and decode phases across GPUs. A separate serving simulation models request arrivals, queues, and cache transfer. For Llama-3.1-Instruct-70B to Llama-3.2-Instruct-1B, it predicts up to 33.86X faster requests and 27.5X lower energy use than using the larger model for both prefill and decode phases.

    LLM 推理分为两个瓶颈不同的阶段：LLM 预填充在每个请求中运行一次，计算密集；解码则对每个输出 token 重复执行，受内存带宽限制。为应对这一问题，人们提出了不同的解决方案，但这些方案在预填充和解码阶段都使用同一个模型。我们提出 BridgeKV，在预填充阶段使用较大的模型，在解码阶段使用同一系列中较小的模型。一个轻量级 KV 拼接模块将大模型的提示缓存转换为小模型的缓存布局。该模块通过学习得到的局部层混合，以及针对键和值分别设计的非线性映射，处理缓存形状和表征方面的差异。在两个模型都冻结的情况下，我们训练该模块对齐它们的缓存，并使小模型遵循大模型的下一 token 预测。若需要进一步的任务适配，第二阶段训练会加入低秩适配器。在六组模型配对和五个数据集上，BridgeKV 在全部 30 种设置下都优于可训练参数预算相同的微调小模型基线。它将相较于预填充和解码阶段都使用大模型的方案的质量差距缩小了最多 80%。在一块 A40 GPU 上，从 Llama-3.1-Instruct-8B 到 Llama-3.2-Instruct-1B 的组合，其请求处理速度比单独使用大模型快 3.0X，延迟接近单独使用小模型。BridgeKV 可以改进跨 GPU 分离预填充和解码阶段的硬件与系统方案。另有一项服务仿真对请求到达、队列和缓存传输进行建模。对于从 Llama-3.1-Instruct-70B 到 Llama-3.2-Instruct-1B 的组合，仿真预测，相较于在预填充和解码阶段都使用大模型，请求处理速度最高可快 33.86X，能耗可降低 27.5X。

    SoMem gives agents control over organizing, revising, and retrieving persistent document-based memory, with evaluations showing improved performance across three benchmarks.     In most LLM agents, weights are fixed after deployment, so new information must be retained in external memory. Existing approaches often rely on predefined records and fixed organizational rules, which cannot readily accommodate evolving tasks and interactions. This raises the question: can LLM agents organize their own memory using ordinary documents? We introduce self-organized memory (SoMem), a framework that stores memory in linked documents. The agent decides what to summarize, how to group related information, and when to revise existing topics, and every summary it produces stays linked to the original interactions as evidence. The runtime validates updates and automatically derives temporal, relational, and recent-memory views from the organized content. At query time, the agent chooses what to search and read, following document links and inspecting original evidence as needed. On LoCoMo, BEAM-100K, and LongMemEval-S, SoMem outperforms the strongest baseline by 2.66, 3.10, and 2.00 percentage points, respectively. The constructed memory can be reused across models, and additional reasoning effort can further improve answer quality.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    A worked solution can make self-generated training targets shorter and cheaper, but accuracy on the practiced operation may hide how well a model can reuse newly learned rules. We study this choice in a 2B-parameter reasoning model learning two invented quantitative rules. The model generates targets from a rule sheet alone or from the sheet plus a program-written worked solution; targets are accepted for final-answer correctness, and the support is removed for fine-tuning and evaluation. Training questions request forward use in one segment; composition requires sequential reuse of the same rule across two segments. After six passes, using a program-checked numerical signature, sheet-only targets lead by 24.3 percentage points (95% item-bootstrap CI 14.6-34.0) on composition in a prospective test. On unseen argument values, observed forward accuracy is identical (87.5% each), but composition accuracy is 58.3% versus 23.6%, a 34.7-point gap (25.7-43.8). An independently sampled second target-bank pair repeats the direction (+14.6 points, 2.1-26.0). Ten passes on the shorter worked-solution targets, approximately matching the domain tokens of six sheet-only passes while changing other training quantities, narrow the gap to 16.3 points (6.3-26.7) in the first bank pair and 6.2 points (-6.3 to 18.8) in the second, where the pre-specified test does not hold. At six passes each, the worked-solution policy uses fewer capture tokens and less update time, yet the trained models use 2.6 times as many generated tokens per composition success under the numerical signature (2.1 times in the second bank pair). Choosing a capture context therefore requires testing how the new rules are reused, alongside the inference cost of those uses, rather than relying on forward accuracy alone.

    RAT formally models how an agent harness can load and unload modules, with results on behavior preservation, composition order, reasoning complexity, and execution.     RAT 对智能体框架如何加载和卸载模块进行形式化建模，并给出关于行为保留、组合顺序、推理复杂度和执行的结果。框架架构和形式化推理是核心；模块组合是实质性但范围较窄的贡献，论文没有声称研究模型的内部表示。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Action theories typically fix their vocabulary and causal laws, whereas agent harnesses can change their tools, providers, and policies during execution. We introduce Reconfigurable Action Theories (RAT), in which actions can change the action theory itself. A theory module in RAT contains a vocabulary, causal laws, and an initializer. A RAT configuration records the active modules and the world state. Module loading and unloading are represented by actions governed by ordinary causal laws. RAT retains the standard causal action semantics of its language fragment when the active module set is fixed. We give sufficient conditions for at most one next configuration, preservation of existing behavior when a module is added, and equal results when modules are loaded in either order. We establish the computational complexity of reasoning tasks in RAT and translate finite RAT systems into nonmonotonic causal theories and Answer Set Programming (ASP), preserving bounded executions. Experiments compare finite RAT models with executions of official DeepSeek Harness, Pi, and OpenHands implementations. RAT provides a formal basis for checking how component changes affect a harness's available actions, behavior, and reachable goals.

    World models enable agents to plan and learn from imagined experience, but in an unfamiliar environment they must learn its mechanics from limited interaction. We ask how many exposures a world model needs to predict the effects of a new environment's mechanics. Half of them reach that accuracy within about 80 exposures, in a single play of the game, and without updates only one in seven does at all. In closed-loop play on the public games, WARC-Agent, which pairs WARC with a fixed graph explorer, triples the explorer's official efficiency score from 0.15 to 0.46, mostly through test-time training.     ENGLISH

    Multilingual generation requires large language models (LLMs) to determine both what to say and in what language to say it, yet these two commitments are difficult to disentangle from model outputs alone. We use translation as a controlled probe: for multi-parallel segments that a model translates well in one language direction but poorly in another, content is held fixed while language varies. Using activation patching, we write residual-stream states from successful runs into failing ones and compare content-matched states with content-independent controls, allowing us to trace content-specific and language-related signals across layers. Across three LLMs of different scales and architectures, we find a consistent three-stage pattern of multilingual generation. Intermediate layers first express a default English signal; content information becomes causally available one layer later; and the final target language is resolved only at later layers. The ordering of the English default before content also appears in a reading-comprehension task. Our sparse autoencoder analyses reveal a further dissociation: the intermediate language signal is only weakly represented by sparse features, whereas a later language distinction is clearly sparse, but resists intervention at the patched position. These results provide a mechanistic account of how language selection and content information emerge and interact during multilingual generation.

We impose the known structure and learn only the remainder: an exact non-commutative group law sits in the node of a self-contained layer, its edges learn local increments, and a zero-initialized correction psi learns unknown deviations of the law. A pre-training criterion predicts exact representability. On fixed-angle SU(2) composition, a 54-parameter dense edge is the most accurate dense model, at 27x fewer parameters than the strongest fixed-matrix baseline, and lies 0.05 deg above the Bayes floor. On real robot arms, an isolated 306-parameter psi reaches 1.12-1.14 mm versus 1.29-1.33 mm for Gauss-Newton at N >= 60, and the recipe transfers across three vendors and two protocols.     ENGLISH

    Interpretability tools are usually built for one model at a time: a refusal direction, a truthfulness probe, or a steering vector is found with labeled data inside the model it explains. We ask whether such tools can be carried to other models through a map between residual streams fit only on unlabeled prompts. We transfer a refusal direction, tested causally by addition and ablation, and two read-out tools, a correctness direction and a sentiment probe, across 110 pairs of models from five families and 1B to 72B parameters and between base and instruction-tuned models, with controls for specificity and five seeds. How much transfers depends on what the map was fit on. A map fit on ordinary questions recovers 54\% of the target's own refusal steering and 16\% to 77\% of its correctness gain; adding unlabeled prompts from the region where the tool operates raises these to 102\% and 88\% to 98\%, while control directions recover at most 1\%. We prove that a linear map behaves this way whenever two models correspond linearly on the data it covers, and a label-free coverage score derived from this result tracks recovery across more than 16,000 runs and explains earlier reports that maps between models fail across domains. Carried read-out tools outperform anything the target's unlabeled representations yield. Interpretability results, once found, can be reused across models at the cost of a few unlabeled prompts.

    可解释性工具通常针对单个模型构建：在它要解释的模型内部，利用带标签的数据找到拒绝方向、真实性探针或引导向量。我们研究能否通过仅用无标签提示拟合的残差流映射，将这类工具迁移到其他模型。我们在来自五个模型家族、参数规模从 10 亿到 720 亿的模型之间，以及基础模型与指令微调模型之间的 110 对模型上，迁移了一个拒绝方向（通过加法和消融进行因果检验）以及两个读出工具（正确性方向和情感探针），并使用特异性控制和五个随机种子。迁移效果取决于映射所用的拟合数据。在普通问题上拟合的映射，可恢复目标模型自身拒绝引导效果的 54%，以及正确性提升效果的 16% 到 77%；加入工具发挥作用区域中的无标签提示后，这两个数值分别提升至 102% 和 88% 到 98%，而控制方向最多只能恢复 1%。我们证明，只要两个模型在映射覆盖的数据上呈线性对应，线性映射就会表现出这种性质。由此结果推导出的、无需标签的覆盖度分数，可在超过 16,000 次运行中预测恢复效果，并解释了早先关于跨领域模型映射失效的报告。迁移过来的读出工具优于目标模型的无标签表征所能提供的任何工具。一旦发现可解释性结果，只需少量无标签提示便可在模型之间复用。

    Safe Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Turn Clinical Agents: When Dense Rewards Beat Outcome Rewards

    多轮临床智能体的安全强化学习：密集奖励何时优于结果奖励

    Brendan P. Murphy, Agustina Saenz

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper studies how reward design shapes information gathering and decision procedures in multi-turn agents, finding that dense process credit can improve held-out performance while outcome rewards permit harmful shortcuts. This directly advances reasoning training and evaluation, and substantially informs agent decision procedures; the clinical setting alone does not support composition or interpretability scores.

    该论文研究奖励设计如何影响多轮智能体的信息收集和决策流程，发现密集过程奖励能够改善留出集表现，而结果奖励可能诱发有害捷径。这直接推进了推理训练与评测，并实质性地探讨了智能体决策流程；临床场景本身并不能支撑组合或可解释性方面的贡献判断。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards is increasingly used to improve language model reasoning, yet its effects on sequential decision procedures remain poorly understood. We study this problem in clinical multi-turn agents that must decide what information to request, when to stop gathering evidence, and which action to take. We introduce three controlled environments: medication refill triage, acute diagnostic work-up, and dosing titration, each with hidden clinical states, query costs, exact adaptive oracles, and deterministic outcome verifiers. Across these tasks, outcome-only group relative policy optimization often improves aggregate reward while producing undesirable procedures, including premature commitment, one-question collapse, and failures on rare high-risk cases. In diagnostics, assigning dense credit to questions that reduce uncertainty improves held-out value and moderate-case support across three training seeds relative to outcome-only reinforcement learning, without the high-risk seed collapse observed under outcome-only training. Separating exploration from exploitation further increases high-risk support at its best checkpoint, but at the cost of excessive information gathering on low-acuity cases. Additional experiments show that the optimal strength of process credit is task-dependent; that after a supervised warmup that already gathers carefully, reinforcement learning raises aggregate reward by trimming questions while degrading high-risk performance; and that reinforcement learning does not reliably repair rare behavior gaps inherited from biased supervised data. Verifiable final outcomes are therefore insufficient for training reliable multi-turn agents: reward design must account for the procedure used to reach an answer, and evaluation must distinguish adaptive information gathering from reward-exploiting shortcuts.

    中文

    带可验证奖励的强化学习越来越多地用于提升语言模型推理能力，但它对序贯决策过程的影响仍缺乏充分理解。我们在多轮临床智能体中研究这一问题：这类智能体必须决定请求哪些信息、何时停止收集证据，以及采取何种行动。我们构建了三个受控环境：药物续配分诊、急性诊断检查和剂量滴定；每个环境都包含隐藏的临床状态、查询成本、精确的自适应预言机和确定性的结果验证器。在这些任务中，仅使用结果奖励的组相对策略优化往往会提高总体奖励，却导致不理想的流程，包括过早作出判断、退化为只问一个问题，以及在罕见高风险病例中失效。在诊断任务中，与仅使用结果奖励的强化学习相比，对能够降低不确定性的问题给予密集信用，可在三个训练随机种子下提升留出集价值和中等病例覆盖率，且没有出现仅用结果奖励训练时观察到的高风险种子性能崩溃。将探索与利用分开，在最佳检查点上能进一步提高高风险病例覆盖率，但代价是在低急症级别病例中收集过多信息。其他实验表明，过程奖励的最佳强度取决于任务；即使监督预热阶段已经会谨慎收集信息，强化学习仍会通过减少提问提高总体奖励，同时损害高风险病例表现；而且强化学习无法可靠地弥补偏置监督数据中遗留的罕见行为缺陷。因此，仅验证最终结果不足以训练可靠的多轮智能体：奖励设计必须考虑得出答案所采用的流程，评测也必须区分自适应信息收集和利用奖励漏洞的捷径。

    MaxIM: Maximally Informative Incremental Summarization via Reinforcement Learning

    MaxIM：通过强化学习实现信息量最大化的增量式摘要

    Jihwan Jeong, Guy Tennenholtz, Yinlam Chow, Chih-Wei Hsu, Craig Boutilier

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    MaxIM uses information-theoretic reward shaping and a variational critic to train incremental summaries that preserve task-relevant information under memory limits, improving long-horizon task utility. This substantially advances memory design and credit assignment for learning, while its relevance to reasoning is meaningful but indirect and the abstract does not study internal representations or compositional generalization.

    MaxIM 通过信息论奖励塑形和变分评论家，在记忆受限的条件下训练增量式摘要保留任务相关信息，从而提升长时程任务效用。该方法实质性地推进了记忆设计和学习中的信用分配；它与推理的关联具有一定意义，但较为间接，且摘要没有研究内部表示或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    AI systems must often maintain bounded memory of unbounded interaction histories. However, optimizing the memory representation, and its updates, for downstream task utility is difficult for standard reinforcement learning (RL) due to severe credit assignment bottlenecks induced by sparse, delayed rewards. We introduce MaxIM (Maximally Informative Incremental Memory), a framework that formulates incremental summarization as a capacity-constrained, information-theoretic reward-shaping problem. Grounded in value suboptimality bounds, we show that bounding sequential information loss motivates maximizing the predictive log-likelihood of future, task-relevant targets, a variational lower bound on predictive sufficiency. We introduce a recursive consistency condition to ensure summaries are grounded by maximizing mutual information (MI) with the observed history. We mitigate credit assignment issues with a parameterized asymmetric critic that computes step-wise variational MI bounds for dense reward shaping. Empirical evaluation on long-horizon scientific reading and multi-turn dialogue benchmarks shows that MaxIM outperforms RL, supervised fine-tuning, and prompt-focused baselines on factual grounding, comprehensive autorater metrics, and downstream task utility across strict token budgets and extended horizons, without the need for expensive human preference labels.

    中文

    人工智能系统常常必须在有界记忆中维护无界的交互历史。然而，稀疏且延迟的奖励会造成严重的信用分配瓶颈，因此标准强化学习（RL）难以针对下游任务效用优化记忆表示及其更新。我们提出 MaxIM（信息量最大化增量记忆），一个将增量式摘要表述为容量受限的信息论奖励塑形问题的框架。基于价值次优界，我们证明，限制序贯信息损失意味着要最大化未来任务相关目标的预测对数似然；该目标是预测充分性的变分下界。我们提出递归一致性条件，通过最大化摘要与观测历史之间的互信息（MI），确保摘要以历史为依据。我们使用参数化的非对称评论家缓解信用分配问题；该评论家计算逐步变分 MI 界，用于密集奖励塑形。在长时程科学阅读和多轮对话基准上的实证评估表明，在严格词元预算和延长时程下，MaxIM 在事实依据、综合自动评分指标和下游任务效用方面均优于 RL、监督微调和侧重提示词的基线，而且无需昂贵的人类偏好标签。

    Zheng Jiang, Fang Niu, Bo Peng, Houde Qian, Wenyi Li, Deyao Hong, Mingju Gao, Yizhe Chi, Youjie Zheng, Kaisen Yang, Calvin Xiao, Lifeng Sun, Huan-ang Gao

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    WorkflowArena measures how LLM agents organize executable multi-agent workflows, and experiments show that delegation structure can affect task performance. This directly advances agent organization and evaluation; task solving and coordination have some connection to reasoning and composition, but the abstract does not study reasoning mechanisms or compositional generalization.

    WorkflowArena 衡量 LLM 智能体如何组织可执行的多智能体工作流，实验表明委派结构会影响任务性能。这直接推动了智能体组织与评估的发展；任务求解和协调与推理及组合有一定联系，但摘要并未研究推理机制或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language model agents are increasingly deployed as multi-agent systems rather than as a standalone model operating within a single context. Recent agent harnesses allow the model to instantiate worker agents and to author the executable workflow that coordinates them, shifting the design of system structure from developers to the model at run time. The quality of this organization therefore constitutes a distinct capability, yet existing benchmarks either measure end-to-end task completion or evaluate coordination under structures specified in advance. We formalize this capability as workflow orchestration and introduce WorkflowArena, a benchmark of 145 long-horizon tasks spanning 8 professional domains, from software engineering and formal mathematics to legal analysis and 3D production. Each task specifies an initial workspace and an integrated deliverable composed of interdependent components, which is assessed by a hidden verifier. Agents determine autonomously whether and how to delegate, and all delegation is recorded, enabling joint evaluation of deliverable quality and the organization of the underlying work. Experiments with nine models show that no single configuration performs best across all domains and that systems exhibit distinct delegation strategies: at high effort, Claude models in Claude Code invoke workflows less frequently but with larger worker groups, whereas GPT models in Codex delegate more frequently in smaller units. When the executing model is held fixed on a challenging subset of tasks, workflows authored by Claude Opus 5.5 substantially improve weaker executors, indicating that workflow organization is itself a measurable determinant of task performance.

    大型语言模型智能体越来越多地以多智能体系统的形式部署，而非作为在单一上下文中运行的独立模型。近期的智能体框架允许模型实例化工作智能体，并编写用于协调它们的可执行工作流，从而在运行时将系统结构的设计权从开发者转移给模型。因此，这种组织能力的质量构成了一项独特能力；然而，现有基准要么衡量端到端任务完成情况，要么评估在预先指定的结构下进行的协调。我们将这项能力形式化为工作流编排，并推出 WorkflowArena，这是一个包含 145 项长时程任务的基准，涵盖 8 个专业领域，从软件工程和形式数学到法律分析和 3D 制作。每项任务都指定一个初始工作空间，以及一份由相互依赖的组件构成的集成成果，并由隐藏验证器进行评估。智能体自主决定是否委派以及如何委派，所有委派都会被记录，从而能够联合评估成果质量及底层工作的组织方式。对九种模型的实验表明，没有任何单一配置能在所有领域中表现最佳，且各系统呈现出不同的委派策略：在高工作量设置下，Claude Code 中的 Claude 模型调用工作流的频率较低，但工作组规模更大；而 Codex 中的 GPT 模型委派更频繁，但每次委派的工作单元更小。在一组具有挑战性的任务中固定执行模型后，由 Claude Opus 5.5 编写的工作流显著提升了较弱执行模型的表现，这表明工作流组织本身是任务性能中一个可衡量的决定因素。

    HiVe-Mem: Interleaving Horizontal Memory Expansion and Vertical Evidence Composition for Multimodal Agents

    Haozhen Zhang, Bohan Liu, Jianzhu Bao, Qingyuan Liu, Haodong Yue, Xiao Li, Zi Pong Lim, Wenya Wang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    HiVe-Mem introduces a multimodal agent memory architecture that expands retrieval through relational neighbors and composes query-adaptive evidence, with benchmark gains and reduced token use. Evidence composition provides a partial connection to compositional methods, while memory organization and use are the central systems contribution.

    HiVe-Mem 提出一种多模态智能体记忆架构，通过关系邻居扩展检索并组合适应查询的证据，同时带来基准性能提升并减少 token 使用。证据组合与组合方法存在一定联系，而记忆的组织与使用是其核心系统贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    As multimodal agents accumulate increasingly long interaction histories, effectively retrieving and utilizing past information becomes critical for long-term interaction. Existing memory systems typically rely on semantic retrieval over compressed memories and expose predefined representations, which may miss relevant memories and overlook heterogeneous evidence needs across queries. We introduce \textbf{\hivemem}, a multimodal memory framework that interleaves \textbf{\textsc{H}}or\textbf{\textsc{i}}zontal Memory Expansion with \textbf{\textsc{Ve}}rtical Evidence Composition. For horizontal memory expansion, \hivemem organizes memory episodes into a relational graph using textual and visual anchors, expanding semantically retrieved seeds with related neighbors to recover complementary information. For vertical evidence composition, each retrieved memory retains multiple evidence forms, including compact summaries, captions, grounded visual views, raw images, and interaction history. A lightweight trainable selector independently composes an evidence subset for each retrieved memory, enabling query-adaptive utilization of heterogeneous multimodal information. This two-dimensional design jointly broadens memory coverage and adapts the evidence contributed by individual memories. Experiments across three multimodal memory benchmarks show that \hivemem consistently improves task performance across base models while reducing token consumption by about 90\% compared with the most efficient competing multimodal baselines.

    中文

    随着多模态智能体积累越来越长的交互历史，有效检索和利用过去的信息对于长期交互至关重要。现有记忆系统通常依赖对压缩记忆进行语义检索，并提供预定义的表示形式，因此可能遗漏相关记忆，也可能忽视不同查询对异质证据的需求。我们提出 \textbf{\hivemem}，一种多模态记忆框架，将 \textbf{\textsc{H}}or\textbf{\textsc{i}}zontal Memory Expansion（横向记忆扩展）与 \textbf{\textsc{Ve}}rtical Evidence Composition（纵向证据组合）交错融合。对于横向记忆扩展，\hivemem 使用文本和视觉锚点将记忆片段组织成关系图，并通过相关邻居扩展语义检索得到的种子记忆，以恢复互补信息。对于纵向证据组合，每条检索到的记忆都保留多种证据形式，包括精简摘要、说明文字、基于视觉内容的视图、原始图像和交互历史。一个轻量级的可训练选择器会为每条检索到的记忆独立组合一个证据子集，从而能够根据查询自适应地利用异质多模态信息。这种二维设计既扩大了记忆覆盖范围，也能调整各条记忆所提供的证据。跨三个多模态记忆基准的实验表明，与最高效的竞争多模态基线相比，\hivemem 在不同基础模型上始终提升任务性能，同时将 token 消耗降低约 90\%。
